jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Job summary  

Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer\-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data\-driven decisions and analytical problem\-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.  

  

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile \- where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile \- where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile \- when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.  

  

Key Responsibilities and Job Elements:  

* Support, mentor, and motivate your salaried and hourly workforce
* Lead large\-scope projects with site and regional impact
* Build and execute productivity plans through forecast reviews, determining productivity requirements, and partnering with other Leaders to load balance
* Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises
* Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
* Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
* Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
* Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
* Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
* Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)


Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Operations Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of employee and performance management experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2\+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
* Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 1\+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
* Experience managing a team of 2\+ salaried employees and 70\+ indirect employees
* Experience scoping, leading, and implementing process improvements through: Lean process, Kaizen, and/or Six Sigma.
* Demonstrated problem solving skills and analytical skills
* Excellent customer service skills, communication skills and interpersonal skills
* Track record of meeting or exceeding department performance goals
* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain/Logistics, or a related field.
* Experience in: military, manufacturing, automotive, biotech, electronics, energy, instrumentation, machinery, defense/aerospace, medical, cosmetics, production, or distribution environments.

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

* Experience with different contract types, such as FFP.
* Experience in financial management, performance management, business management, process management, resource management, risk assessment and risk management processes and procedures, and change management

jobs.description:
**EHDD is looking for someone who gets architects and gets AI.**


EHDD is an 80\-year\-old, design\-forward practice with deep sustainability roots and a real appetite to lead, not follow, on how AI reshapes architectural practice. We're looking for someone to help us get there.


You'll be embedded within project teams, connecting coding and AI tools to real workflows and identify opportunities for efficiency and key workflows to target for automation.

 **What You'd Do**

* Partner directly with the team on our AI strategy and adoption roadmap
* Be the go\-to person connecting coding/AI tools to real workflows across our MS 365 stack, including Copilot and Power Automate
* Pilot, test, and roll out AI tools across project management, design, documentation, visualization, accounting, marketing, and project delivery. Teach the firm how to actually use them.
* Drive adoption through training, documentation, and ongoing support to ensure new tools become part of everyday practice
* Track and communicate the impact of new tools and workflows through metrics such as time savings, user adoption, project efficiency, and information quality
* Capture and share successful workflows, templates, prompts, and lessons learned to build the firm's collective knowledge base
* Project administration tasks such as:
	+ Assisting with project startup and closeout
	+ Preparing milestone documents with the design team and consultants
	+ Maintaining design team directories in MS Teams and TonicDM
	+ Managing design team access to MS Teams, Bluebeam, and other platforms
	+ Reinforcing file naming, metadata, and organization standards across platforms

**What You Bring**

* Attention to detail and strong ownership of problems and situations, from start to finish
* Genuine tech curiosity and self\-starter energy \- you go find the answer before someone asks you to
* Comfort, ideally fluency, in MS 365 and Claude; Revit knowledge is a plus, along with general ease across creative/visualization and collaboration tools
* Strong communication \- you can explain a workflow fix to a team, and a technical constraint to IT, in the same afternoon
* Architecture, engineering, or construction (AEC) practice experience is strongly preferred. You're embedded on project teams day to day, so firsthand knowledge of how projects actually run matters, even as strong tech instincts are the priority
* Working knowledge of project management, design, documentation, and project delivery workflows and deliverables
* Strong technology judgment and systems thinking \- you understand not just how to use tools, but when and why a particular platform, database, automation, or AI solution is the right fit
* Ability to balance innovation with practicality, focusing on solutions that teams will actually adopt and maintain

 **What Matters Most**


Energy, communication skills, curiosity, and the ability to lead from the middle. This is a partner in a team seat, someone who earns trust project by project, not a mandate from above.

 **What We Offer**


EHDD is an award\-winning, majority woman\-owned firm providing architecture, interiors, planning, and urban design services. We offer competitive benefits, including medical/dental/vision insurance with HSA, transportation benefits, and professional development support.


Notable projects include the Eames Institute, the AIA Headquarters Renewal, YouTube Headquarters, Monterey Bay Aquarium, The Exploratorium, Goldendale Observatory, and Point Defiance Zoo Aquarium.

*We are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. Women, minorities, individuals with disabilities, and protected veterans are encouraged to apply.*

 **Application Process**


Submit a resume and a letter of interest describing your relevant project administration, technology, and AI/automation experience. Work samples that show a workflow, tool, or process you've built or improved are welcome but not required.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Overview:

Within SSOE’s Advanced Technology division, we specialize in high\-tech facility design, offering top\-tier design and engineering services to a diverse array of clients and markets. Our team is composed of highly skilled and knowledgeable professionals who excel across various disciplines. We pride ourselves on our cross\-disciplinary approach, which allows us to understand and address our clients' needs more comprehensively than traditional, siloed methods. What sets us apart is our ability to seamlessly conceptualize, plan, and detail every aspect of design. Our in\-house experts collaborate closely, optimizing and enhancing our work through multi\-discipline strategy sessions. By leveraging cutting\-edge techniques and state\-of\-the\-art software, we deliver industry\-leading technology and innovative solutions from day one.  

The **Senior Project Manager** leads complex, multidisciplinary design and delivery efforts for advanced technology facilities, with a focus on cleanroom environments, fab support systems, and high\-tech industrial infrastructure. This role manages scope, schedule, budget, quality, and risk across all phases of delivery, from early planning and basis of design through construction administration. The Senior Project Manager works closely with clients, discipline leads, subconsultants, and internal project teams to coordinate technical decisions, review design packages, resolve field issues, and maintain project momentum. The role also drives change management, best practices, and proactive communication to support predictable, high\-quality project outcomes in fast\-moving, highly regulated environments.
AI and Innovation:

At SSOE, we don’t just talk about the future, we build it. As a leader in industry AI adoption, we empower our team to work smarter by providing responsible access to the industry leading AI Large Language Models, vibe\-coding platforms, and securely integrating advanced tools into every role. From day one, you’ll receive the training and support needed to leverage AI as a core tool for enhancing productivity, sparking creativity, and streamlining complex workflows.
Responsibilities:
* Lead planning and execution of complex semiconductor and advanced technology facility projects from pre\-design through construction administration, ensuring alignment with client objectives, technical requirements, and project delivery milestones.
* Develop and manage project scope, budgets, schedules, staffing plans, and execution strategies for large, multidisciplinary design and construction efforts, including design\-build and integrated project delivery environments.
* Coordinate with discipline leads in mechanical, electrical, plumbing, structural, process, controls, and architectural teams to integrate cleanroom, fab support, utility, and high\-performance building systems into cohesive project deliverables.
* Guide basis of design development, design narratives, engineering calculations, and technical reviews for facility systems and mission\-critical infrastructure.
* Oversee QA/QC review gates, interdisciplinary coordination, and milestone deliverable reviews to ensure accuracy, constructability, code compliance, and alignment with client standards and operational requirements.
* Manage client communication and decision\-making throughout the project lifecycle, including executive reporting, design reviews, issue resolution, and presentation of technical impacts.
* Direct change management processes, including scope evaluation, budget and schedule impact analysis, contingency planning, and negotiation of modifications with clients, contractors, and internal teams.
* Coordinate with vendors, equipment suppliers, and specialty consultants to support equipment integration, procurement planning, utility interfaces, and technical submittal review for critical systems and long\-lead items.
* Lead construction administration activities such as RFIs, submittals, field observations, site walks, punch list coordination, and resolution of design or installation issues during construction and turnover.
* Identify project risks early and implement mitigation strategies related to design complexity, schedule constraints, phased occupancy, safety, permitting, and operational continuity.
* Promote a strong safety culture by coordinating with project teams and contractors to address life safety, construction safety, and operational risk considerations throughout project delivery.
* Mentor project team members and emerging project managers, reinforcing best practices in communication, technical coordination, documentation control, and client service.
* Contribute to pursuit support, proposal development, and project planning efforts for new semiconductor and advanced technology opportunities as needed.


Qualifications:
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, preferably Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Civil/Structural, or a closely related technical discipline is hihgly preferred.
* Demonstrated project management experience of 10 or more years, with significant focus on the design and delivery of industrial, advanced technology, or high\-tech manufacturing facilities such as semiconductor fabrication facilities, data centers, or similar mission\-critical environments.
* Proven experience leading projects in a design\-build or integrated project delivery environment, with responsibility for scope, schedule, budget, quality, and client satisfaction.

**PROJECT MANAGER**  

*This position is based out of Mutiple locations.*  

  

**About ArchKey**  

  

ArchKey is one of the nation’s largest privately held specialty trade installation and integrated facility service companies. We are a leader in designing, building and maintaining electrical, technologies and specialty systems. We’re the POWER behind making the improbable possible.
  

  

We’re electrifying the nation, energizing the future and bringing communities to life like never before. What we do today shapes the vision of tomorrow. Our work impacts lives long after the building is done. This means we are committed to building in ways that are not just technologically advanced, but sustainable, scalable and equitable by all. We’re not just energizing infrastructure, we’re energizing careers, communities, and the future.
  

  

Made up of the brightest minds in the industry, our team is our greatest asset, bringing knowledge, skills, and experience to every project. This is more than a call to join us, it’s an invitation to be part of a visionary journey, to grow with us as we scale.  

  

**About the Position**  

  

As a Project Manager, you will support the planning, execution, and financial performance of electrical construction projects while coordinating project teams, field leadership, and clients to deliver successful outcomes. Project Managers may independently lead smaller projects or work alongside Senior Project Managers or Project Directors on larger and more complex projects.  

  

This role provides an opportunity to further develop project leadership skills while supporting the delivery of increasingly complex electrical construction projects. As Project Managers gain experience and demonstrate strong performance, they may progress into Senior Project Manager roles with expanded leadership responsibility for larger and more complex projects.

* Can work autonomously and creatively solve problems.
* Has a growth mindset and is always looking to continually learn and grow.

* Partners with leadership to provide strategic input to key objectives and decisions affecting the business unit and functional work group. Conducts high\-quality business development and job solicitation in the marketplace, in partnership with other Company leaders. * Lead and align the project team, including project managers, engineers, and field leadership, ensuring strong coordination between office and field operations.
* Support preconstruction and pursuit efforts, including estimating input, scope development, value engineering, and participation in contract negotiations
* Lead project planning and execution, including staffing strategy, procurement planning, schedule development, and coordination with engineering and field teams.
* Oversee project financial performance, including budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and change order management.
* Manage client and partner relationships, serving as a primary point of contact for owners, general contractors, and key project stakeholders.
* Provide leadership for project safety, reinforcing company safety programs and expectations across all project activities.
* Lead contract administration and risk management, including major procurement decisions, subcontract strategy, and change management.

* Maintain a working understanding of IBEW labor agreements, supporting coordination with union leadership and compliance with applicable labor standards.

  

**Minimum Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in electrical, mechanical, or civil engineering, project management, business administration, construction management, or a related field.
* Minimum 3\-5 years of project management experience. Extensive project management training and skills—thorough understanding of the project life cycle.
* Minimum 2 years of project management work experience in construction (electrical distribution/substation, renewable energy or related disciplines).
* Experience with computerized estimating systems and software, preferably Accubid. Experience and proficiency using Accubid, Revit, CAD, SKM, ADGI, Navisworks, and/or BIM systems is a plus.
* Trained and proficient in project management tools and techniques, negotiating, budgeting, estimating, costing, contracting, scheduling, pricing, and common code requirements. Keen understanding of the National Electric Code. Skills to read, interpret and understand financial documents, electrical bids, contracts, plans, drawings, blueprints, and specifications.
* Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills with the ability to lead project teams and coordinate with clients, contractors, and field leadership.
* Working knowledge of the National Electrical Code (NEC) and general electrica

We’re looking for someone rare.

Not just a “salesperson.”

Not just a “people person.”

Someone who can care deeply AND hold the line.

Someone who can sit across from a patient in pain, truly hear them…

…and confidently guide them to make a decision that could change their life.

**This Role Is For You If:**

● You build trust quickly and naturally—people feel safe opening up to you

● You’re empathetic, but not passive—you can lead conversations with confidence

● You don’t avoid hard conversations—you handle them with clarity and care

● You believe in what you’re offering, and that conviction comes through

● You’re driven, resilient, and don’t get discouraged by objections

● You take ownership of outcomes—not just effort

**This Role Is NOT For You If:**

● You rely on pressure or “pushy” sales tactics

● You struggle to guide people toward decisions

● You avoid uncomfortable conversations

● You need constant supervision or motivation

● You’re just looking for “another sales job”

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

● Welcoming new patients and creating a strong first impression

● Leading meaningful consultations that uncover patient goals, fears, and motivations

● Educating patients on their condition and recommended care

● Guiding patients through care plan decisions with clarity and confidence

● Supporting patients with financing options when needed

● Following up to ensure patients stay engaged and committed to their care

● Collaborating with the team to create a seamless patient experience

**About the Role:**

This is not cold calling. Patients are already coming to us for help.

Your job is not to “sell” them—

It’s to help them make a decision they’ve likely been avoiding.

**That requires:**

● Emotional intelligence

● Strong communication

● Confidence under pressure

● And a genuine belief in the care we provide

**What We Offer:**

● A purpose\-driven environment where your work truly impacts lives

● A high\-demand, niche service with strong patient interest

● Structured training to help you master communication and patient conversion

● A supportive, positive team culture (no negativity, no ego\-driven sales tactics)

● Base salary \+ uncapped commission

Typical earnings: $500\-$3000\+, based on performance

What We’re Looking For:

● Sales or consultative experience preferred

● Strong interpersonal and communication skills

● High level of organization and personal accountability

● Ability to learn quickly and adapt

● Professional, reliable, and team\-oriented

Schedule:

Full\-time

Monday–Thursday: 10:00 AM–7:00 PM, Saturday 8:30 AM to 1:30 PM

This role sits at the intersection of healthcare and influence.

If you’re someone who can combine heart, confidence, and drive—

you’ll not only succeed here… you’ll thrive.

Pay: $28\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
If you're ready to be part of our legacy of hope and innovation, we encourage you to take the first step and explore our current job openings. Your best is waiting to be discovered.  



Day \- 08 Hour (United States of America)
**This is a Stanford Health Care Tri\-Valley job.**  

  

**A Brief Overview**  

The Quality, Safety \& Regulatory Program Manager supports the Interventional and Procedural Services Platform by coordinating quality metrics, safety event follow\-up, regulatory readiness, infection prevention partnership, radiation/contrast/sedation safety tracking, high\-level disinfection oversight coordination, and procedural safety standards.
  

  

Reporting to the Senior Director of Quality and PI, the Program Manager works closely with the VP of Interventional Services, Senior Director of Procedural Nursing and Clinical Operations, Platform Medical Director, specialty medical directors, managers, Quality, Patient Safety, Infection Prevention, Regulatory, Radiation Safety, Pharmacy, and other partners to ensure the platform has reliable quality infrastructure and visible accountability for improvement.
  

  

This role is intended to be a central integration point for procedural quality, safety, and regulatory work. The Coordinator does not replace department\-level accountability; rather, the role creates standard processes, dashboards, follow\-up discipline, and escalation pathways across OR, Cath Lab, Interventional Radiology, Endoscopy, SPD, Pre/Post, and related procedural services.
  

  

**Locations**  

Stanford Health Care Tri\-Valley
  

  

**What you will do**

Quality Dashboard and Performance Monitoring


* Develop, maintain, and coordinate platform quality and safety dashboards for OR, Cath Lab, Interventional Radiology, Endoscopy, SPD, Pre/Post/PACU/Procedural Recovery, and related procedural services.
* Track procedural quality indicators, infection prevention indicators, procedural complications, sedation events, radiation dose outliers, contrast events, unplanned transfers/admissions, retained item risks, specimen labeling defects, endoscope reprocessing compliance, sterilization biological indicator failures, and other agreed measures.
* Prepare routine reports for the Monthly Procedural Quality and Safety Committee, Interventional Services Executive Council, and leadership review.

Safety Event Review and Corrective Action Coordination


* Coordinate review, classification, follow\-up, and closure tracking for procedural safety events, near misses, regulatory findings, and improvement actions.
* Support root cause analysis, apparent cause analysis, action planning, audit design, and evidence collection in collaboration with Quality and Patient Safety partners.
* Ensure action plans have owners, timelines, evidence of completion, and sustainment measures.

Regulatory Readiness and Survey Support


* Coordinate procedural regulatory readiness activities, mock survey preparation, tracers, documentation audits, policy review, competency tracking evidence, and survey response support.
* Maintain readiness focus for surgical/procedural safety standards, sedation safety, high\-level disinfection, infection prevention, radiation safety, contrast safety, medication safety, specimen handling, and SPD/sterilization processes.
* Partner with managers to identify gaps, escalate risks, and support timely corrective action.

Cross\-Functional Improvement and Standardization


* Support standardization of policies, procedures, checklists, audits, dashboards, and escalation pathways across procedural areas.
* Facilitate interdisciplinary improvement workgroups as assigned, including sedation safety, procedural verification, high\-level disinfection, infection prevention, radiation/contrast safety, and SPD/OR reliability.
* Promote a Just Culture, high\-reliability principles, C\-I\-CARE, and transparent learning from events.

Key Performance Metrics


* Timeliness and completeness of quality dashboards, monthly reporting, action item closure, and sustainment audits.
* Safety event follow\-up completion, corrective action verification, regulatory readiness scores, audit completion, and survey finding closure.
* Performance trends in sedation safety, radiation/contrast safety, infection prevention, retained item risk, specimen labeling defects, endoscope reprocessing compliance, sterilization monitoring, and procedural complications.
* Manager and physician leader satisfaction with quality reporting, escalation visibility, and improvement support.

Employee must perform all duties and responsibilities in accordance with the C\-I\-CARE Standards of the Hospital. C\-I\-CARE is the foundation of Stanford Health Care Tri\-Valley’s patient experience and represents a framework for patient\-centered interactions.  



  

**Education Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in nursing, healthcare administration, quality management, public health, clinical discipline, or related field required. Master’s degree preferred.

  

**Experience Qualifications**

* Minimum of four (4\) years of healthcare experience in quality, patient safety, regulatory readiness, perioperative/procedural services, infection prevention, nursing, or clinical operations.
* Experience with quality dashboards, safety event analysis, regulatory surveys, infection prevention, high\-level disinfection, sedation safety, radiation or contrast safety, or procedural environments preferred.

  

**License/Certification**

* Clinical license preferred when applicable to candidate background. CPHQ, CPPS, CIC, or related quality/safety/regulatory certification preferred.

  

**Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

* Knowledge of healthcare quality, patient safety, regulatory standards, performance improvement, audit methods, and event follow\-up.
* Ability to work independently, organize complex cross\-functional work, and influence without direct authority.
* Strong data management, dashboard coordination,

jobs.title: Creator & Community Program Lead — Grok Imagine
jobs.description:
SpaceXAI's mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands\-on and to contribute directly to the company's mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE:**



The Imagine Product team is redefining AI\-driven media experiences for Grok users worldwide. In this role, you'll build the communications system that meets creators where they are: public proof of what Grok Imagine can do, programs that show creators how it makes them faster, more cost\-efficient, or more ambitious, and a community that runs from individual makers to production houses. The job is to move the brand from talking about itself to making other people talk about it — through proof, craft, and community. If you're a hands\-on communicator who can turn product capability into credible stories, repeat advocates, and a feedback loop back into the product, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.


### **RESPONSIBILITIES:**


* Own creator and community communications strategy for Grok Imagine — plan and execute outreach that turns product capability into visible proof, creator adoption, and durable brand affinity.
* Build and ship product\-showcase content across owned channels.
* Design and run influencer programs as two distinct motions: awareness partners who put Grok Imagine in front of volume, and craft partners.
* Build relationships with production houses, studios, and in\-house creative teams. Get Grok Imagine into real editorial and post\-production pipelines, and run a two\-way channel so professional workflow feedback reaches the product.
* Manage external production when in\-house capacity is not enough — bidding, contracts, workflow, and quality control — in close partnership with creative leads who set the taste bar for anything that ships under Grok's name.
* Track how competing AI media products talk to creators and professionals. Build the measurement that shows which communications work actually drives adoption, and that can support investment in the work.

### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**


* Proven experience leading communications, creator partnerships, or community programs for a consumer or creator\-facing product, including shipped showcases, tutorials, case studies, or creator programs that moved people from curiosity to practice.
* Hands\-on operator: you can write a brief, run outreach, ship a content calendar, manage a vendor, and stand up a curation and rights\-clearance pipeline without a large team underneath you.
* Experience working with creators, influencers, or professional media practitioners, and judgment about which voices confer reach versus which confer credibility.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; you can be precise with internal partners and compelling with external audiences.
* Strong editorial judgment and a clear standard for what can go out under the brand.
* Comfort operating in a small, high\-velocity team alongside product, research, design, and engineering.

### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**


* Background in AI\-driven media, generative tools, or adjacent creative software.
* Experience running both broad\-reach influencer programs and credibility\-building partnerships with working professionals.
* Familiarity with production, post\-production, or studio workflows — and how new tools actually enter them.
* Experience managing agencies or production vendors end to end.
* Analytics\-informed content practice: using performance data to set cadence, format mix, and spend.
* Demonstrated taste in visual and motion media, and a point of view on what makes generative work look professional rather than novel.
* Prior work moving a product's public perception from novelty to working tool.

$140,000 \- $196,000 USD



Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at xAI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short \& long\-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

jobs.title: Training Lead, Safety & Operations
jobs.description:
### **Who we are**



Gatik, the leader in autonomous middle\-mile logistics, is revolutionizing the B2B supply chain with its autonomous transportation\-as\-a\-service (ATaaS) solution and prioritizing safe, consistent deliveries while streamlining freight movement by reducing congestion. The company focuses on short\-haul, B2B logistics for Fortune 500 retailers and in 2021 launched the world's first fully driverless commercial transportation service with Walmart. Gatik's Class 3\-7 autonomous trucks are commercially deployed across major markets, including Texas, Arkansas, and Ontario, Canada, driving innovation in freight transportation.



The company's proprietary Level 4 autonomous technology, Gatik Carrier™, is custom\-built to transport freight safely and efficiently between pick\-up and drop\-off locations on the middle mile. With robust capabilities in both highway and urban environments, Gatik Carrier™ serves as an all\-encompassing solution that integrates advanced software and hardware powering the fleet, facilitating effortless integration into customers' logistics operations.


### **About the role**



The Head of Training establishes, matures, and leads the technical training infrastructure across all operational sites. This role ensures that testing, field deployment, and engineering support teams operate at the highest standards of safety, technical competence, and operational efficiency.



This role is onsite 5 days a week at our Santa Clara, CA office!



### **What you'll do**


* **Program Development \& Maturity:** Build, refine, and standardize training curricula for testing, deployment, and engineering support personnel, aligning content directly with safety benchmarks and operational milestones.
* **Technical Translation \& End\-to\-End Execution:** Take complex technical engineering material and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), translate them into clear, accessible training materials, and execute the resulting training programs end\-to\-end.
* **Critical Procedures \& Processes:** Take responsibility for ensuring the organization is thoroughly trained on all critical procedures and processes, embedding standard operating procedures (SOPs) deeply into daily workflows to maintain strict safety and operational integrity.
* **Administrative Compliance \& Traceability:** Implement rigorous record\-keeping frameworks to monitor, document, and audit all training metrics, ensuring total traceability and audit\-readiness across the organization.
* **Quality Assurance \& Delivery Oversight:** Audit and evaluate field trainers to ensure faithful, standardized execution of training content and rigorous testing methodologies across all facilities.
* **Continuous Elevation \& Real\-Time Monitoring:** Establish dynamic competency matrices to track team capabilities in real\-time, delivering ongoing learning modules to continuously elevate technical skills alongside hardware/software updates.
* **Retraining \& Recertification:** Develop, maintain, and execute structured retraining workflows to address skill gaps, post\-incident remediation, and routine safety recertifications.

### **What we're looking for**


* **Autonomous Systems Experience:** Demonstrated track record leading technical training or operational safety programs within the autonomous vehicle (AV), deployed robotics, or safety\-critical technology sectors.
* **Commercial Trucking Awareness:** Strong technical familiarity or direct experience with autonomous commercial trucking operations, including operational logistics and related safety protocols, is highly preferred.
* **Multi\-Site Leadership:** Proven ability to scale training operations, manage remote trainers, and standardize processes across geographically distributed operational hubs.
* **Administrative Rigor:** Experience utilizing Enterprise Learning Management Systems (LMS) and capability tracking platforms with strict data integrity requirements.
* **Willingness to Travel:** Ability to travel frequently to all operational, testing, and deployment locations.


Salary Range \- $180,000\- $260,000


### **More about Gatik**



Founded in 2017 by experts in autonomous vehicle technology, Gatik has rapidly expanded its presence to Mountain View, Dallas\-Fort Worth, Arkansas, and Toronto. As the *first and only* company to achieve fully driverless middle\-mile commercial deliveries, Gatik holds a unique and defensible position in the AV industry, with a clear trajectory toward sustainable growth and profitability.



We have delivered complete, proprietary AV technology \- an integration of software and hardware \- to enable earlier successes for our clients in constrained Level 4 autonomy. By choosing the middle mile – with defined point\-to\-point delivery, we have simplified some of the more complex AV challenges, enabling us to achieve full autonomy ahead of competitors. Given extensive knowledge of Gatik's well\-defined, fixed route ODDs and hybrid architecture, we are able to hyper\-optimize our models with exponentially less data, establish gate\-keeping mechanisms to maintain explainability, and ensure continued safety of the system for unmanned operations.



Visit us at Gatik for more company information and Careers at Gatik for more open roles.

* Automotive News: Gatik foresees hundreds of self\-driving trucks on road soon, and that's just the beginning
* Forbes: Isuzu And Gatik Go All In To Scale Up Driverless Freight Services

jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program or project management.
* Experience with supply or demand planning (e.g., demand forecasting, inventory management, resource allocation, etc.).
* Experience developing planning models for new product introduction (NPI).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience managing cross\-functional or cross\-team projects.
* Experience in data modeling, trend analysis, statistics, forecasting, and business insights.
* Excellent investigative skills.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.


The Supply Chain Planning team within Cloud supply chain operations, is responsible for optimal fulfillment and transformation of Google’s fleet by balancing and shaping demand intent from product areas, planning new technology, and driving supply capability across data centers, networking, and machines.  

  

As a Demand and Supply Planning Program Manager, you will be accountable for the order life\-cycle, culminating in on\-time product delivery. **A Better Built World**
------------------------


At Miter, we’re on a mission to help construction contractors build with confidence. If we’re successful, we’ll make it easier and faster to build critical physical infrastructure \- roads, bridges, utilities, data centers, housing, etc.


For decades, construction and field services contractors have had to run their businesses on outdated software: clunky, on\-premise systems created in the 1980s and 1990s.


That’s where Miter comes in. We’re using AI and embedded payments to rebuild the core HR, finance, and operations systems that underpin our physical economy. Using Miter, contractors like Marathon Electrical, W.J. O’Neil, and Truebeck Construction are building stronger teams, controlling job costs, and accelerating jobsite execution.


This idea is resonating. Since we launched in 2021, we’ve grown to thousands of customers and tens of millions in ARR, making us one of the fastest growing vertical software companies ever. To double\-down on our momentum, we’ve raised $50M\+ from top investors (Bessemer, Coatue, and Battery) who share our belief that we’re just getting started.


Miter is the operating system for the construction industry — helping construction companies manage payroll, HR, and finance in one platform built for how the field actually works. Our Customer Support team is the front line for every payroll, benefits, and tax question our customers run into, and we're looking for a Manager, Customer Support to lead and grow a subset of that team: owning queue health, SLA performance, escalations, and coaching across our entire platform.

**What You'll Do**

* Lead and grow a subset of the Customer Support frontline team, owning day\-to\-day queue health, SLA performance, escalations, and coaching across our entire platform.
* Set and drive SLA and productivity targets for your team, using support metrics (SLA, CSAT, cases/day, backlog) to spot problems early and act on them.
* Serve as the escalation point and QA authority for complex payroll, tax, and benefits\-enrollment cases, ensuring the team's toughest tickets get resolved accurately and fast.
* Assist in hiring, onboarding, and developing support ICs — building or refining specialization and escalation paths as the team scales.
* Coach with a player\-coach mindset: lead by example, give direct feedback, and grow people toward the next level, while personally working customer cases when volume or urgency demands it.
* Configure and optimize our help desk/ticketing platform — queues, routing, macros, and reporting — to keep the team efficient as ticket volume grows.
* Ramp quickly on our product and build the coaching/training frameworks that help your team do the same.
* Set clear standards and hold your team accountable to SLAs, without sacrificing team morale or the customer experience.

**What You'll Need**

* 4\+ years in customer support/success, including 2\+ years managing a support team at a payroll, HR tech, construction software, or accounting software company.
* Enough payroll depth to hold your own on construction\-specific complexity — certified payroll, prevailing wage, union fringes, and multi\-state field crews — or a demonstrated ability to get there fast.
* A track record of hitting and improving SLA and productivity targets for a queue\-driven team.
* Experience hiring, onboarding, and developing support ICs; building or refining specialization/escalation paths.
* Comfort operating in a fast\-paced, ticket\- or queue\-driven environment.
* Fluency in help desk/ticketing platforms (Pylon, Zendesk, Intercom, Front) — configuring queues, routing, macros, and reporting, not just using them.
* Comfort building and reading support metrics (SLA, CSAT, cases/day, backlog) and acting on them.
* A strong enough grasp of the payroll/tax/benefits domain to be the team's escalation point and QA complex cases.
* Ability to ramp quickly on a complex SaaS product, and experience building coaching/training frameworks for a team. Comfort utilizing AI tools and workflows.
* A player\-coach mindset — leading by example, giving direct feedback, and growing people toward the next level, while being willing to work customer cases directly when volume or urgency demands it.
* High ownership under pressure.
* The ability to set clear standards and hold a team to SLAs without hurting morale.
* An empathetic, service\-minded approach, with genuine curiosity about the construction industry and our customers' day\-to\-day operational reality.

**Nice to Have**

* Hands\-on familiarity with construction or accounting software — Sage, Intacct, Procore, Viewpoint, Foundation, or similar — either as a user, implementer, or support professional.

**Location \& Compensation**


This is an M1\-level role, with target base compensation of approximately $150K. Final range and location details will be confirmed during the hiring process.

**Our Benefits:**
-----------------

* **Competitive Compensation:** We offer competitive (well above “market”) salary, commission, and equity packages.
* **Medical Insurance:** Comprehensive medical, dental, FSA, vision plans to suit you and your family’s needs.
* **401(k) Retirement Plan:** Company\-matched contributions to help you plan for your future.
* **Flexible PTO:** Take the time you need to recharge and be your best self.
* **Parental Leave:** Generous 16\-week paid leave for all parents, including adoptive and foster parents.
* **Learning \& Development:** We offer every employee an annual educational allowance to explore external professional development.
* **Office Extras:** Snacks, coffee, lunch, and commuter benefits for in\-office Mitosaurs.
* **Community**: Company\-wide and team\-specific off\-sites per year.

Description:

As the world leader in calibration services, Trescal delivers precision measurement solutions across every major industry, geography, and instrument type. Our network of technical experts and accredited laboratories ensures the highest standards of quality, compliance, and performance.


The **Key Account Manager (KAM)** is responsible for maintaining, strengthening, and expanding existing customer relationships within an assigned portfolio of strategic accounts. This role focuses on account retention, organic growth, and long\-term partnership development, ensuring customers receive consistent value, high service levels, and solutions aligned with their operational and regulatory requirements.


The Key Account Manager serves as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, working cross\-functionally to identify opportunities for expanded services, improved coverage, and multi\-site or multi\-service agreements—particularly within regulated environments such as Life Sciences, Pharmaceuticals, Aerospace, and Electronics Manufacturing.

**Responsibilities:**

**Account Management \& Retention**

* Own and manage a defined portfolio of existing key accounts, acting as the primary commercial and relationship lead.
* Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders across quality, engineering, operations, and procurement.
* Ensure contract compliance, customer satisfaction, and long\-term retention through proactive engagement.

**Growth \& Expansion**

* Identify opportunities to grow revenue within existing accounts through service expansion, additional sites, bundled solutions, and contract renewals.
* Promote calibration, on\-site services, asset management, validation, and other value\-added offerings aligned to customer needs.
* Lead pricing discussions, renewals, and upsell initiatives while protecting margin and profitability.

* Willingness to travel periodically within the assigned region.

**Benefits:**


At Trescal, we believe our people are the cornerstone of our success. We offer comprehensive health benefits, paid time off, a 401(k) plan, professional development opportunities, and a collaborative, growth\-oriented environment.

***Trescal is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*** *All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.*

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Nice to have:**
-----------------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**Hi! We're Forerunner.**
=========================


Stronger, more resilient communities are built by the people inside government and regulated industries who keep critical infrastructure running. But they're working against real headwinds: fragmented data, field crews without the right tools, and high\-stakes decisions made without a complete picture.


Forerunner exists to fix that. We build intelligent software that connects the systems these agencies and firms already rely on, fills the gaps those systems can't, and turns fragmented information into decisions and actions that reduce liability, surface revenue, and prevent small problems from becoming emergencies.

**About the role**
------------------


As a Customer Success Manager, you will own the ongoing success of a full book of business — from onboarding through renewal — ensuring every account realizes measurable value from Forerunner and grows into a durable, trusted partnership. You'll work at the intersection of relationship management, product adoption, and account growth, partnering with Sales, Product, and Engineering to keep outcomes on track.

**What you'll do**
------------------

### **Customer Health \& Retention**

* Serve as a trusted advisor to your accounts, understanding their workflows and goals well enough to guide them toward renewal.
* Own customer health across your portfolio, using data and regular check\-ins to catch risk early and keep accounts moving toward measurable outcomes.
* Guide customers through public\-sector and regulated\-industry decision cycles with patience and clear communication.

### **Product Adoption**

* Partner with the Deployment Specialist to take a clean handoff at go\-live and carry momentum into the ongoing success phase.
* Drive adoption through user communications, customized in\-app onboarding, and continued learning so customers get full value from their investment.
* Configure customer environments and settings as needs evolve, using both the product front end and Forerunner's internal tools.

### **Account Growth**

* Identify and pursue expansion opportunities — upsells, add\-ons, and cross\-sells — within your accounts.
* Partner with Sales and leadership to build the case for expansion and drive it to close.

### **Cross\-Functional Partnership**

* Share customer feedback, ideas, and concerns with Product and Engineering to inform the roadmap.
* Evangelize customer success stories across your accounts to help build the broader Forerunner community.

### **Team Building**

* Contribute to the ongoing development of CS policy, process, and playbooks as an early member of a growing team.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 4\-6 years of professional experience in customer success, account management, or client services, with a track record of managing end\-to\-end renewals and proactively uncovering expansion opportunities within a portfolio.
* Experience serving government agencies or regulated industries — GovTech, floodplain management or flood insurance, GIS/mapping, or public\-sector project management are all relevant backgrounds, though not required.
* Comfortable managing complex, public\-sector relationships and decision cycles; experience partnering with government clients or supporting complex public\-sector workflows is a plus.
* An excellent, empathetic communicator — you're often a customer's first point of contact, and building trust matters in our space.
* Detail\-oriented and committed to quality, with genuine enthusiasm for creating customer value.
* Comfortable with a high degree of ambiguity — able to prioritize independently and take on responsibility as the team grows.
* Experience supporting SaaS software is preferred but not required.

**You'll thrive in this role if you...**
----------------------------------------

* Believe in delivering measurable outcomes to customers, not just checking off tasks.
* Enjoy being a trusted point of contact and building long\-term relationships.
* Are comfortable balancing day\-to\-day account management with longer\-term account strategy.

**Our team has a lot to offer.**
--------------------------------


Forerunner is an early\-stage company with an interdisciplinary team. We are motivated by seemingly intractable problems and work hard to support one another.

* **We're mission\-driven.** Our mission orients our business strategy and pushes us to work with a sense of urgency. We're in the weeds — our entire team spends time engaging with our partners in the field to better understand the real\-world problems they face.
* **We're a small team.** As a member of our growing team, you will quickly become an invaluable part of our organization and have a meaningful impact on our business and technical direction. We welcome unique perspectives and backgrounds. Your opinion matters and we hope you'll share it.
* **We build each other up.** A team works best when its members are equipped with the tools to tackle the problems they're facing. Forerunner strives to provide meaningful feedback and learning opportunities to help all our team members grow.
* **We value in\-person connection**, so we keep offices in NYC, San Francisco, and Portland, ME. Roles can be hybrid or fully remote, depending on the work.
* **We want you to be happy and healthy.** Forerunner offers competitive compensation, health/vision/dental coverage, a 401k plan, and one expensed lunch per week. We also have a quarterly wellness reimbursement so you can define what "health" means to you.
* **The salary range for this position** is $90,000\-$120,000 with an OTE of $105,000\-$135,000\. This posting may span more than one career level. Compensation is determined based on a variety of factors, including an individual's skills, experience, and qualifications.


Forerunner is an equal opportunity employer committed to embracing diversity and the perspectives of individuals from all backgrounds.

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Lead
jobs.description:
Nobody has rebuilt a brokerage with AI before. So a lot of the strategic questions that decide how big Corridor gets don’t have answers yet, and we need to work them out over the next eighteen months.  

  

That’s the job. What does it cost us to serve a client, and how fast does that number fall as agents pick up more of the work? Which segments are worth going after and which ones are quietly losing us money? Do we grow by hiring advisors, franchising them, or buying their books, and what is a book woroth anyway? What has to change about how we’re organized when there are three times as many of us?  

  

You’ll report to our COO and work closely with our CEO.  

In this role, you will

* Figure out our unit economics, which nobody in this industry has. What a client costs to serve with AI automations, how many one person can carry once agents are doing the work, which products make money
* Build the case for our biggest growth bets, from franchising producers to general agency economics to buying books outright, then help us pick
* Work out how we hyperscale. We want to be several times this size next year, and help us think through what will break as we scale
* Automate your own job. You’ll write agent prompts and skills and stand up workflows with AI coding tools yourself, not file tickets and wait on engineering
* Own the operating rhythm. Which KPIs we hold ourselves to, getting them measured automatically instead of assembled by hand, and running the reviews where we look at them
* Pick up the important things nobody owns yet
* Build the infrastructure underneath all of this, across legal, regulatory, and people, and get it running without you

  

You’ll be a good fit if:

* You have incredibly high grit and horsepower, combined with excellent judgment
* You have 2\-6 years of experience, with a strong foundation in investment banking, private equity, consulting, or another rigorous analytical environment, and ideally time since in an operating role
* You have a strong bias for action
* You’re low\-ego
* You’re comfortable getting deep into revenue structures and unit economics
* You like running things \- you’re comfortable owning a process, a vendor, or a messy cross\-functional project end to end
* You have a track record of outperforming in selective, demanding environments
* You take a messy question, structure it fast, and get to a defensible answer
* You have good judgment on sensitive matters, and people trust you with them

jobs.description:
Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and is on track to double our revenue in the next 18 months. To meet and exceed this target, Stord is strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.


By combining comprehensive commerce\-enablement technology with high\-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator\-built software suite including OMS, Pre\- and Post\-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.


With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end\-to\-end commerce solutions combine best\-in\-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.


Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like AG1, True Classic, Native, Seed Health, quip, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry\-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top\-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.


This is an opportunity to own the marketing operations function at a high\-growth company. Reporting to the Director of Revenue Operations, the Senior Marketing Operations Manager will build the system Stord uses to analyze pipeline: where it comes from, how it converts, where it stalls, and how it tracks against target. You will stay on top of that data week to week and recommend what to change to grow pipeline, then work with Marketing and Sales to make the changes and measure the results.
  

  

Alongside that, you will own the core marketing operations function: administering HubSpot as our marketing automation platform, running lead routing, and building the marketing attribution model that feeds the pipeline analysis.
  

  

This is a hands\-on role. You will work closely with Demand Generation, Events, Content, Customer Marketing, Sales, and the SDR team.
**What You’ll Do**
==================

  

**Pipeline Analysis \& Recommendations**
----------------------------------------

* Build the reporting system Stord uses to analyze pipeline end to end: pipeline created by source and channel, stage conversion rates, velocity, coverage against targets, and where deals stall, with Salesforce as the system of record
* Stay on top of pipeline week to week: know what is moving, what is stalled, and where the numbers are off trend, and flag it before it shows up in a quarterly miss
* Recommend specific changes to improve pipeline (channel mix, campaign targeting, lead scoring, routing, SDR follow\-up, ICP fit) and work with Marketing and Sales leadership to put them in place and measure whether they worked
* Provide the data and analysis behind the weekly pipeline review and the monthly and quarterly GTM reviews, and make sure campaigns and programs are set up to be measured before they launch

**Marketing Attribution \& Reporting**
--------------------------------------

* Build Stord’s marketing attribution model, breaking out pipeline and revenue contribution by channel: demand generation, paid advertising, events, content and brand, partnerships, and SDR outbound
* Own multi\-touch attribution in Salesforce, using Salesforce Campaigns and campaign influence to track marketing\-sourced and marketing\-influenced pipeline from first touch through closed won, with HubSpot as the upstream data source
* Build and maintain marketing performance reporting for executive leadership and the Board of Directors, including pipeline by source, channel ROI, funnel conversion, and spend efficiency
* Manage UTM structure, tracking parameters, and campaign tagging standards in HubSpot so attribution data is consistent across programs and platforms
* Refine the attribution model over time as channels and tools change, and document the methodology so Marketing, Sales, and Finance are working from the same definitions
* Develop and maintain dashboards for weekly, monthly, and quarterly GTM reviews, and support pipeline reporting and forecasting as needed

**Lead Routing \& Funnel Conversion**
-------------------------------------

* Own lead management from capture to opportunity: forms and lead capture, lead scoring, qualification criteria, and routing from HubSpot into Salesforce
* Update and optimize lead routing and assignment rules so inbound leads reach the right SDR or AE quickly, with clear SLAs and speed\-to\-lead targets
* Build routing that is sustainable: documented, testable, and able to hold up as territories, teams, and headcount change without constant manual fixes
* Measure the impact of routing changes on stage conversion rates (lead to MQL, MQL to SQL, SQL to opportunity) and pipeline created, and adjust based on results

jobs.title: Strategy and Operations Manager, TikTok Shop
jobs.description:
**Job description**

**About Boost Engine**

Boost Engine is a tech\-led company redefining global brand growth through AI. Founded in 2024, we've quickly become a leading growth partner for TikTok Shop in the US market — surpassing tens of millions of dollars in monthly GMV, named TikTok's **Top Annual Ecosystem Partner** (one of only 5 worldwide), and recognized on **Forbes' Startups 100 list**.

We don't just use AI — we build it. Our proprietary systems, **OperaX** and **AutoBoost**, apply AI agents across market research, business analysis, strategy design, performance monitoring, data processing, and operational execution, helping global brands drive over $20M in monthly GMV growth.

Humans define the vision, make the business calls, and own the results. Agents unlock the productivity to get there. We're looking for growth talent who want to work alongside AI — using it to handle research, analysis, and monitoring, so you can focus on judgment, communication, and decisions that move the business. Join us as we push AI from answering questions to getting work done.

AI beyond "answering questions" toward "getting work done and delivering results."

**The Role**

You'll work on real business problems for US consumer brands — researching how brands grow, how they enter social commerce, and how they connect content, creators, distribution, and transactions — then turn that analysis into compelling business proposals, and executable plans.

This isn't a traditional e\-commerce operations role, and it isn't a pure proposal\-writing role either. We don't require prior experience with TikTok Shop, social commerce, or creator marketing — that's not the filter we're using. What matters more than industry vocabulary is whether you can get back to first principles on an unfamiliar business, quickly identify the variables that actually drive growth, profit, competition, and resource allocation, form an independent and well\-reasoned judgment, and use AI to go deeper and turn your method into something reusable.

**What You'll Do**

* Research and analyze — study US consumer brands, industry trends, consumers, competitive landscape, and business models; turn ambiguous client asks into clear problem definitions, hypotheses, and analysis plans; get to the core drivers of revenue, margin, and competitive position fast, even in an industry you've never worked in; separate fact from assumption and verify the data behind any claim
* Design brand growth and social commerce strategy — analyze how brands connect brand, product, content, creator, distribution, and transaction; study how brands grow from awareness to purchase to repeat in social commerce; diagnose bottlenecks across product, content, channels, and execution; turn judgment into a growth strategy with clear KPIs and risk boundaries, balancing short\-term sales against long\-term brand building
* Produce English proposals and business materials — independently or collaboratively build BD proposals, pitch decks, business cases, market entry plans, growth strategies, campaign plans, and JBPs; connect client goals, market evidence, and our capabilities into one coherent narrative; iterate quickly with the US BD, Strategy, and Operations teams based on feedback; own the logic, data integrity, and quality of what you deliver
* Build AI skills, agents, and workflows — use "vibe coding" to turn your own research and analysis methods into working tools: prompts, templates, knowledge bases, skills, or agents the team can reuse; break frequent tasks into clear inputs, process, outputs, and human checkpoints; test new models and tools and decide what's worth keeping based on real results
* Own the quality of AI output — never take AI\-generated content as the final answer; verify research, data, and conclusions; decide what AI should own versus what needs your judgment; catch hallucinations, gaps, or unverified claims before they reach a client

**What We're Looking For**

* Excellent structured thinking and business analysis — able to break down a complex, ambiguous problem into a clear framework
* Able to get up to speed fast in an unfamiliar industry — build a point of view, find evidence, and test hypotheses without relying on existing playbooks
* Sharp on business fundamentals: revenue, margin, customer needs, competitive advantage, resource allocation
* Excellent written and spoken English — able to independently produce professional, client\-ready materials
* Independent judgment — doesn't default to convention, and doesn't take AI output at face value either
* High self\-direction — moves forward on incomplete information instead of waiting for instructions
* Genuine, ongoing interest in applying AI — not just using it to write faster, but actively testing new models, agents, and automation tools
* Real "vibe coding" experience — you can point to at least one AI skill, agent, or automated workflow you've actually built and used
* No computer science or traditional engineering background required, but a real builder mentality is

*Note: TikTok Shop, social commerce, and creator marketing experience are explicitly not required for this role — we're optimizing for how fast you can get past "I haven't done this before" and arrive at a better answer than someone who has.*

**Nice to Have**

* Background in management or strategy consulting, corporate strategy/corporate development, investment or industry research, market entry or growth strategy, or strategy/BizOps/special projects at a high\-quality startup
* English\-language proposals, pitch decks, investment memos, or strategy work you can share
* Experience working through a real, complex, information\-incomplete business problem
* Familiarity with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Replit, Lovable, n8n, Zapier, or similar tools
* Hands\-on experience with agents, RAG, API workflows, or internal data/business tooling
* Experience with US consumer brands, cross\-border business, DTC, marketing, or growt
