jobs.title: Client Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Company:** VidTech  
**Location:** Remote, United States  
**Type:** 1099 Independent Contractor \| Per\-Project

**About VidTech**

VidTech is a Commercial Real Estate media and technology company producing video, drone, photography, 3D, virtual tour, and other digital media for commercial real estate professionals.

We're a fully remote team that combines innovative technology with a strong belief in exceptional, personal customer service.

This is **not a traditional Project Manager role** centered around project plans, reporting, and internal meetings.

At VidTech, our Project Managers are the **face and owner of the client's project**.

You'll communicate directly with clients, coordinate drone pilots, photographers, videographers, editors, and internal teammates, keep projects organized, and solve problems when things don't go according to plan.

The most important skills for this role are:

* **Exceptional communication**
* **Organization and follow\-through**
* **Coordination**
* **Problem\-solving**
* **Flexibility**
* **Ownership**

You do **not** need extensive technology, commercial real estate, or media production experience. You also don't need to already know tools like HubSpot, Asana, or Vimeo.

Those things can be taught.

What matters most is your ability to work confidently with clients, keep multiple moving pieces organized, communicate clearly with different people, adapt when circumstances change, and find solutions.

**What You'll Do**

For your assigned projects, you'll:

* Serve as the primary point of contact for the client
* Understand the client's goals, requirements, and expectations
* Coordinate project schedules, deadlines, and next steps
* Source and coordinate drone pilots, photographers, and videographers when needed
* Coordinate property access and capture requirements
* Communicate project instructions to operators, editors, and internal teammates
* Act as the liaison between clients and our production team
* Translate client feedback into clear revision instructions
* Proactively communicate updates, delays, or changes
* Identify missing information and potential problems before they create delays
* Solve scheduling, production, and client\-service issues
* Manage multiple active projects while keeping information accurate and organized
* Guide projects through final client approval and completion

**Who We're Looking For**

You may be a great fit if you:

* Genuinely enjoy communicating with clients
* Write and speak clearly, professionally, and confidently
* Are highly organized and dependable
* Naturally keep track of details, commitments, and next steps
* Can coordinate multiple people and priorities at once
* Stay composed when something goes wrong
* Look for solutions instead of simply identifying problems
* Are comfortable making decisions without constant direction
* Can adapt when schedules, priorities, or circumstances change
* Take ownership and follow through
* Are comfortable learning new processes and technology

Experience in Client Success, customer service, account management, project coordination, project management, production, operations, or similar client\-facing work is helpful.

Experience with commercial real estate, video, photography, drones, creative production, Asana, HubSpot, Vimeo, or similar platforms is a **plus — not a requirement**.

**Compensation \& Project Volume**

This is a **1099 independent contractor position paid on a per\-project basis**.

**Per\-project compensation ranges from approximately $45–$250**, depending on the type and complexity of the project.

Project scope and duration can vary significantly. Some projects may involve only photography or video capture and can be completed within a few days. More complex projects involving fully edited videos, 3D models, virtual tours, or multiple production components may remain active for several weeks.

Project volume also varies based on company demand, project mix, your availability, and performance. A Project Manager may typically oversee approximately **25–45 active projects at a time**, depending on complexity, while more experienced PMs may be able to manage a higher volume.

Because compensation is tied to the projects you manage, there is meaningful opportunity to **increase your earnings by taking on additional project volume as you become more experienced and demonstrate strong performance**.

Strong performers may also have opportunities to take on greater responsibility and grow with VidTech over time.

**Why VidTech?**

* Fully remote work
* Flexible per\-project workload
* Ability to grow your project volume and earning potential
* Meaningful ownership of your projects and client relationships
* Work across video, photography, drones, 3D, and commercial real estate
* Collaborate with creative and technical professionals across the country and around the world
* Learn new production systems and technologies
* Opportunity for additional responsibility as VidTech grows

**Before You Apply**

You do not need to be a career Project Manager.

You **do** need to be an excellent communicator, organized, dependable, flexible, solutions\-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership when several people are depending on you.

If you enjoy working with clients **and** you're good at keeping people, information, and deadlines organized behind the scenes, we'd love to hear from you.

Pay: $20,000\.00 \- $45,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: FOIA Program Manager
jobs.description:
Ben Allegretti Consulting, Inc. (BAC) is a Service\-Disabled Veteran\-Owned Small Business. Our team of remote professionals has supported federal health programs since 2007, with a focus on human factors engineering, health informatics, and process improvement. We are building a FOIA team to support a federal health agency and are looking for career FOIA practitioners who want their judgment to carry weight.

**Position Summary**

Our FOIA PM leads one major FOIA task grouping, such as routine cases and appeals, litigation, or other agency components, and serves as the primary contact for the government's Contracting Officer's Representative. You will manage the schedule, reporting, quality control, and staff performance for a team of FOIA analysts, and you will stay close enough to the casework to make sound disclosure decisions when they matter.

**What You Will Do**

* Lead a team of FOIA analysts who process routine, backlogged, appeal, and litigation cases from intake through closure.
* Act as the day\-to\-day contact for the Contracting Officer's Representative and agency FOIA leadership, and run bi\-weekly status meetings with agendas and minutes.
* Deliver weekly and monthly progress reports covering cases closed, backlog remaining, risks, and recommendations.
* Manage progress against backlog reduction goals, including closure of the oldest requests and appeals.
* Oversee quality control by reviewing disclosure determinations, exemption rationales, and redactions before work goes to the government.
* Maintain the project management plan, risk register, and staffing plan, and track onboarding, system access, training, and background investigation requirements for the team.
* Identify process and systems improvements and prepare briefings, white papers, and option papers for agency leadership.
* Coordinate with agency components, regional offices, and requesters as directed by the Contracting Officer's Representative.

**What You Bring**

* Masters degree and 8 years directing teams or equivalent experience.
* 10 or more years of federal FOIA experience, including at least 5 years leading or supervising FOIA staff or a FOIA program.
* Working knowledge of the Freedom of Information Act (5 U.S.C. 552\), the Privacy Act, HIPAA, and the foreseeable harm standard.
* Experience with FOIA case management systems such as FOIAXpress and with eDiscovery platforms such as Relativity.
* Strong written communication, including reports, correspondence, and leadership briefings.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust background investigation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* PMP or comparable project management credential.
* Experience at HHS, CMS, VA or another federal health agency.
* Experience supporting FOIA litigation and appeals.
* Track record of reducing a FOIA backlog.
* Process improvement training such as Lean Six Sigma.

**Work Environment and Requirements**

This is a remote position. Work is performed through the agency's virtual desktop environment using government\-provided systems and tools. The role requires the ability to obtain and maintain a federal background investigation (Public Trust) and to complete required security, privacy, and records management training before starting work. US Citizenship required. This position is contingent upon contract award.

The pay range for this position is $125,000 to $140,000 per year. Placement in the range depends on experience and demonstrated FOIA depth.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**

***A bit about this role:***


We are hiring a Quality Assurance Manager to support the QA function within Devoted’s Risk Adjustment organization. This person owns the quality assurance program for our retrospective coding and auditing operations: the policies and SOPs behind it, the team that runs it, and the findings it produces. You will direct the work of a team of QA Reviewers, own the QA relationship with internal operational leaders and vendor partners (including AHS off\-shore coding teams), review escalated charts yourself or facilitate further escalation, and turn findings into education and process changes that raise coding accuracy across the department. You will also inform how technology is used to assist this work in accordance with our acceptable use policy.

***Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:***

* Serve as an expert on ICD\-10\-CM coding guidelines, AHA Coding Clinic guidance, and internal risk adjustment guidance
* Oversee an offshore FDR vendor team of QA Reviewers: set accuracy and productivity standards, review performance against them, and adjust volume allocation based on results
* Escalate staffing, training, and quality gaps to vendor management, which owns hiring, onboarding, and day\-to\-day supervision
* Own and maintain Devoted’s QA policies and SOPs for coding quality, retrospective coding, and audit operations (operational and subject matter owner; subject matter owner for the others)
* Plan QA review coverage and sampling across internal staff and vendors, including AHS off\-shore coding teams, so that samples are representative and review volumes are met
* Perform QA reviews of escalated, disputed, and high\-risk charts, and serving as the internal authority on coding disagreements the team cannot resolve; ensuring diagnoses selected for review are appropriate, accurate, and supported by clinical documentation
* Own the monthly and quarterly QA Scorecard process: accuracy of the findings, delivery to Risk Adjustment leadership, coders, and vendor leaders during meetings, and follow\-through on remediation plans
* Identify documentation and coding trends across reviewers and vendors, present them to department leadership, and convert them into education, job aids, or process changes
* Run the review of individual QA work so the QA team’s own accuracy is measured, and incorporating material findings into the QA process going forward
* Partner with vendor leadership on quality expectations, corrective action, and escalation when performance does not meet standard
* Own timely resolution of coding questions from sources coding on behalf of Devoted, and maintaining the log of questions and answers as outlined by policy or procedure
* Partner with technology and analytics teams on risk adjustment tooling, including AI\-assisted coding: define QA requirements, test releases and enhancements, and provide feedback on design and performance, within acceptable use policies
* Build and run monitoring for tools in production, tracking performance drift and error patterns concentrated in specific conditions, chart types, providers, or member populations
* Support retrospective coding and audits by abstracting medical records or ICD\-10 codes for submission to CMS when volume or complexity requires it
* Recommend process improvements and preparing department reporting so productivity and quality goals are met or exceeded and operational efficiency is optimized
* Serving as a voting risk adjustment coding SME member on Devoted’s Coding Steering Workgroup
* Act in an ethical manner as required under HIPAA’s Privacy and Security rules, handling patient data with uncompromised adherence to the law, including what member data may be sent to which vendor systems
* Perform other related duties as required

***Required skills and experience:***

* Current relevant coding certification recognized by AAPC or AHIMA. Examples of relevant certifications include: CPC, CRC, CCS, CCS\-P
* 7\+ years of recent and related experience in medical record documentation review, diagnosis coding, and/or auditing, including risk adjustment coding
* Experience leading development and presentation of accuracy or performance results to production coders or management
* Sound knowledge of ICD\-10\-CM coding guidelines and regulations to meet regulatory, compliance, and internal policy requirements, and the ability to read medical records and abstract clinical diagnosis codes from documentation

***Desired skills and experience:***

* Expertise in CMS risk adjustment models
* Experience managing or overseeing vendor and/or off\-shore coding teams
* Experience validating or auditing AI\-assisted, NLP, or computer\-assisted coding (CAC) tools, or other automated chart review technology
* Experience writing or substantially revising QA policies, SOPs, or audit sampling methodology
* Communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills, including formatting and presenting QA Review results and delivering findings to staff and vendor leaders

At Miter, we’re on a mission to help construction contractors build with confidence. If we’re successful, we’ll make it easier and faster to build critical physical infrastructure \- roads, bridges, utilities, data centers, housing, etc.


For decades, construction and field services contractors have had to run their businesses on outdated software: clunky, on\-premise systems created in the 1980s and 1990s.


That’s where Miter comes in. We’re using AI and embedded payments to rebuild the core HR, finance, and operations systems that underpin our physical economy. Using Miter, contractors like Marathon Electrical, W.J. O’Neil, and Truebeck Construction are building stronger teams, controlling job costs, and accelerating jobsite execution.


This idea is resonating. Since we launched in 2021, we’ve grown to thousands of customers and tens of millions in ARR, making us one of the fastest growing vertical software companies ever. To double\-down on our momentum, we’ve raised $50M\+ from top investors (Bessemer, Coatue, and Battery) who share our belief that we’re just getting started.


Miter is the operating system for the construction industry — helping construction companies manage payroll, HR, and finance in one platform built for how the field actually works. Our Customer Support team is the front line for every payroll, benefits, and tax question our customers run into, and we're looking for a Manager, Customer Support to lead and grow a subset of that team: owning queue health, SLA performance, escalations, and coaching across our entire platform.

**What You'll Do**

* Lead and grow a subset of the Customer Support frontline team, owning day\-to\-day queue health, SLA performance, escalations, and coaching across our entire platform.

* Ramp quickly on our product and build the coaching/training frameworks that help your team do the same.
* Set clear standards and hold your team accountable to SLAs, without sacrificing team morale or the customer experience.

**What You'll Need**

* 4\+ years in customer support/success, including 2\+ years managing a support team at a payroll, HR tech, construction software, or accounting software company.
* Enough payroll depth to hold your own on construction\-specific complexity — certified payroll, prevailing wage, union fringes, and multi\-state field crews — or a demonstrated ability to get there fast.
* A track record of hitting and improving SLA and productivity targets for a queue\-driven team.

* Fluency in help desk/ticketing platforms (Pylon, Zendesk, Intercom, Front) — configuring queues, routing, macros, and reporting, not just using them.
* Comfort building and reading support metrics (SLA, CSAT, cases/day, backlog) and acting on them.
* A strong enough grasp of the payroll/tax/benefits domain to be the team's escalation point and QA complex cases.
* Ability to ramp quickly on a complex SaaS product, and experience building coaching/training frameworks for a team. Comfort utilizing AI tools and workflows.
* A player\-coach mindset — leading by example, giving direct feedback, and growing people toward the next level, while being willing to work customer cases directly when volume or urgency demands it.
* High ownership under pressure.
* The ability to set clear standards and hold a team to SLAs without hurting morale.
* An empathetic, service\-minded approach, with genuine curiosity about the construction industry and our customers' day\-to\-day operational reality.

**Nice to Have**

* Hands\-on familiarity with construction or accounting software — Sage, Intacct, Procore, Viewpoint, Foundation, or similar — either as a user, implementer, or support professional.

**Location \& Compensation**


This is an M1\-level role, with target base compensation of approximately $150K. Final range and location details will be confirmed during the hiring process.

**Our Benefits:**

* **Medical Insurance:** Comprehensive medical, dental, FSA, vision plans to suit you and your family’s needs.
* **401(k) Retirement Plan:** Company\-matched contributions to help you plan for your future.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager (Contractor)
jobs.description:
Condor Health is seeking an experienced independent professional to serve as a Technical Account Manager (TAM) supporting customers using our SaaS solutions. This role combines customer success, technical account management, analytical problem\-solving, project coordination, product demonstration, and consultative account growth.

**Overview**

The Technical Account Manager serves as the primary relationship and operational point of contact for an assigned portfolio of customers. The TAM is responsible for understanding each customer's use of our solutions, proactively managing service needs, coordinating customer requests and issues, and helping customers successfully use their contracted products and services.

Our customers represent a range of roles and technical backgrounds. The TAM therefore serves as an important bridge between customers and our Product, Engineering, Business Analysis, Project, and Support teams. The TAM must be able to understand product functionality and technical concepts well enough to translate them into clear, practical language for customers, while also accurately communicating customer workflows, needs, and concerns to internal teams.

*The TAM needs enough product and software\-development literacy to recognize what kind of work is needed, get the right people involved, and help shepherd that work through the customer relationship.*

The TAM is not expected to function as a software engineer or Business Analyst. For change orders and other development work, the TAM partners with Business Analysts and technical resources who lead detailed discovery, requirements, and solution definition. The TAM remains the customer\-facing owner and provides project\-management\-style coordination during execution, helping maintain communication, track decisions and actions, surface risks or blockers, and support timely completion.

The role also includes a consultative account\-growth component. TAMs are expected to understand customer needs, identify opportunities where additional products or services may provide value, demonstrate relevant capabilities, and support appropriate account expansion. This is not a quota\- or commission\-based sales role.

* Prepare for and facilitate recurring customer account\-management meetings; develop agendas, review open items, guide discussion, document decisions and action items, and ensure timely follow\-through.
* Investigate and triage customer questions and requests, identify missing information, determine appropriate next steps, and engage the correct internal resources rather than simply routing questions between teams.
* Serve as a translator between predominantly nontechnical customers and internal Product, Engineering, Business Analysis, Project, and Support teams.

* Provide targeted product and feature demonstrations to explain functionality, address customer questions, support adoption, and help customers evaluate potential solutions to identified needs.

* Act as a liaison among customers, internal teams, and vendors when coordination is required.
* Identify and document opportunities to improve account\-management and customer\-facing processes when within contracted scope.
* Perform services in accordance with agreed project procedures and applicable security and confidentiality requirements.

HealthSnap (healthsnap.io) empowers patients and their physicians to improve health outcomes using an innovative platform for modern, proactive patient care. We help healthcare organizations easily manage chronic conditions remotely, and deliver personalized patient experiences when it's needed most.


Be part of an organization built on teamwork, innovation, mutual respect, and equality for all. We believe in the power of prevention over treatment, after our co\-founders experienced how modern healthcare failed their loved ones, they knew there had to be a better way. We believe that every patient deserves to receive the right care, at the right time, and in the right location \- regardless of their condition or status.


We lead with empathy above all else, and place the patient at the center of everything we do. The ideal candidate brings a track record of navigating difficult conversations with confidence, and the structured problem\-solving skills to diagnose challenges and drive action. jobs.title: Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
**ABOUT KION**


Kion is revolutionizing CloudOps and FinOps. We offer a unified approach, delivering multicloud, multi\-org, and multi\-account visibility and controls, empowering organizations to effectively manage their complex cloud environments from a single, centralized platform. At Kion, you’ll join a team that values collaboration, creativity, and building products that make a real impact for customers across industries.


We’re a fast\-growing, Series A startup and we believe employees are our most precious resource. While we’re headquartered outside Baltimore, MD and Washington DC, we are committed to a 100% remote\-first workforce. In addition, Kion offers excellent compensation and outstanding benefits!


If you're passionate about using your expert skills to bring transformational change to a customer’s cloud journey, you'd be a great addition to our team!

 **ABOUT THE ROLE**


As a Technical Account Manager at Kion, you are the primary technical advisor and technical relationship owner for a dedicated portfolio of customers, partnering with the CSM (who orchestrates the account) and the AE (who owns the commercial motion). Your north star is Kion's core value: **Turning Customers into Fans**.


You will run structured, tiered engagement cadences, serve as the connective tissue between customers and Kion's Engineering, Product, and Support teams, and own the technical side of the customer lifecycle from onboarding through renewal. Your customers will span enterprise commercial accounts (life sciences, tech, higher education) and government/defense accounts. Success looks like customers who renew, expand, and advocate for Kion because they trust your technical guidance and feel that you genuinely own their outcomes. You’ll also be joining at an exciting moment: the broader Customer Success team is refining how it works, so you can expect aspects of this role to keep evolving as those improvements take shape.

 **YOUR DAY\-TO\-DAY:**

* Own a named portfolio of 8–10 strategic (Tier 1–2\) accounts plus a pooled set of \~8 mid\-tier accounts (15–18 total), and serve as their primary point of contact for all platform and technical matters
* Lead onboarding for new accounts in your book to a 90\-day time\-to\-value standard — onboarding is the first renewal activity, not a support task
* Run tiered customer syncs: monthly technical check\-ins with strategic accounts, 6–8 week check\-ins with named growth accounts, and quarterly proactive outreach to the pooled book — with structured agendas sent ahead, notes, tracked action items, and a written recap within two business days
* Advise customers on platform upgrades: timing, release notes highlights, known issues, and coordinating phased rollouts from sandbox to non\-prod to production
* Troubleshoot and own customer platform issues end\-to\-end, including compliance dashboard configuration, spend reporting gaps, permissions, integrations, and enforcement policy behavior
* Guide customers on cloud governance and FinOps best practices: budget\-to\-actuals analysis, cost anomaly investigation, multi\-cloud spend visibility, and rightsizing guidance
* Drive adoption of new platform features and capabilities, including AI\-assisted tooling, through demos, working sessions, and proactive outreach
* Maintain accurate, current account health tracking in CRM within 48 hours of every meaningful interaction: open items, sentiment, risk flags, and next steps
* Host the weekly customer office\-hours rotation; answer customer questions within one business day (strategic accounts) or two (pooled book); act on health triggers — e.g., a \>30% usage decline — within one week
* Co\-present quarterly business reviews (Kion Objective Reviews / KORs) for strategic accounts with the CSM — owning the adoption story and roadmap segment — and deliver semi\-annual executive business reviews, annual health reviews, and quarterly written usage \& value reports for mid\-tier accounts
* Serve as the bridge between customers and Kion's Support team, ensuring tickets are scoped correctly, prioritized appropriately, and moving; escalating when they are not
* Represent customer bug reports and feature requests in internal cross\-functional reviews, with context on business impact and urgency
* Attend and contribute to internal rhythms: weekly CSM\+TAM standup, monthly Tier 1 account reviews (with CSM and AE), weekly TAM Sync, Support Team Sync, Bug and Feature Review, Sprint Demos, and monthly Product leadership syncs
* Partner with Account Executives on renewal cycles, expansion opportunities, and Professional Service SOWs
* Contribute to the Kion Success Center knowledge base when documentation gaps are identified based on recurring customer questions
* Engage customers in the Kion community Slack (Cloudunity) with release updates, answers, and discussions

 **HOW YOU'LL BE MEASURED:**

* Time\-to\-value: new accounts reach first measurable value inside 90 days
* Technical health score of your book, and health\-trigger response time
* On\-time delivery of prescribed touchpoints: check\-ins, EBRs, health reviews, and usage reports
* Critical\-issue resolution time and escalation quality
* Renewal outcomes on your book, in partnership with the AE — the adoption story you supply feeds every value recap

 **WHAT WE ARE EXPECTING FROM YOU (I.E., THE QUALIFICATIONS YOU MUST HAVE):**

* 4–8 years in technical consulting, solutions engineering, implementation, or professional services (or equivalent customer\-facing technical depth)
* Relationship\-first mindset: you build genuine trust through consistent follow\-through, technical credibility, and treating customer problems as your own
* Technical fluency in cloud infrastructure: AWS, Azure, GCP, IAM, multi\-account governance, compliance frameworks (NIST, CIS, FedRAMP), and cloud cost management concepts
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; you calibrate your message to the audience, from cloud engine

**A Little About Us**



EDB provides a data and AI platform that enables organizations to harness the full power of Postgres for transactional, analytical, and AI workloads across any cloud, anywhere. EDB empowers enterprises to control risk, manage costs and scale efficiently for a data and AI led world. Serving more than 1,500 customers globally and as the leading contributor to the vibrant and fast\-growing PostgreSQL community, EDB supports major government organizations, financial services, media and information technology companies. EDB's data\-driven solutions enable customers to modernize legacy systems and break data silos while leveraging enterprise\-grade open source technologies. EDB delivers the confidence of up to 99\.999% high availability with mission critical capabilities built in such as security, compliance controls, and observability. For more information, visit www.enterprisedb.com

  



EDB is hiring a Technical Account Manager (TAM) for US. The TAM is responsible for building and maintaining post\-sales relationships with EDB's largest and most complex customers. These customers are typically large accounts adopting Postgres and AI solutions. The TAM serves as a trusted technical advisor to drive successful outcomes and to ensure that the customers become a positive reference and continue their journey on Postgres technology. The TAM is also the customer's primary point of contact into all technical areas of EDB. As such, the TAM's technical abilities are critical in identifying solutions, architecture, troubleshooting issues, and answering technical questions as they arise.


**What you will do…**


* Establish a close working relationship with the customer's senior technical leadership team and become their trusted advisor.
* Help EDB customers maximize the value of their Postgres investment
* Assist EDB customers to develop and deploy Postgres strategies
* Provide technical leadership for the customer's major Postgres initiatives (This may include solutions consulting, architecture guidance, and project management)
* Maintain current functional and technical knowledge of the entire EDB product line
* Provide clear and constructive product feedback to EDB's product management teams based on customer requirements
* Help to document best practices in developing and deploying EDB solutions
* Function as a front\-line technical resource for "best practice" and informal customer questions
* Travel up to 25% of the time as required


**What will give you an edge…**


* At least five (5\) years of hands\-on experience with Postgres, Oracle, DB2 or MS SQL Server; professional certifications in any of the relational databases are desirable
* Advanced technical skills, specifically in data management platforms, operating systems, cloud technologies, and technical architecture
* Knowledgeable about data analytics and AI/ML concepts
* Experience with Kubernetes
* Excellent analytical skills regarding technical and project management issues
* Good understanding of strategic sales process
* Well\-developed organizational skills with an ability to manage competing client demands
* Excellent communications and interpersonal skills, including ability to interact and communicate with CxO level personnel

The Center on Juvenile and Criminal Justice (CJCJ) is a community\-based nonprofit organization whose mission is to reduce society's reliance on incarceration as a solution to social problems. We do this through the provision of programs for persons facing detention, education efforts and policy advocacy, and technical assistance. For more information, visit our website at www.cjcj.org.

CJCJ is currently seeking a dedicated and proactive Case Manager to join our Youth Justice Services team. The main goal is to support and serve youth and transitional\-aged young adults impacted by the justice system. The chosen candidate will develop personalized reentry plans and strategies to reduce unnecessary institutionalization and promote tailored interventions. They will connect youth with community resources and provide ongoing intensive case management and support. The role requires working closely with community stakeholders, including providers, defense attorneys, judges, probation officers, and prosecutors, to ensure a collaborative approach. The position involves working both in the office and in the field within San Francisco and nearby counties.

**Qualifications include:**

● Experience in providing case management or collaborating with individuals impacted by

the justice system.

● Passion for social justice work and ability to work under pressure.

● Experience in juvenile or criminal justice, case management, social work, substance

abuse, non\-profit programming, or other related fields.

● Education in criminal justice, public policy, psychology, sociology, social work, law,

creative writing, journalism, English literature, or related field.

● Detail\-oriented with excellent writing, research, and organizational skills, as well as good

time management.

● Experience in developing case plans is preferred. Demonstrates strong interpersonal

communication skills and communicates effectively with young adults.

● Excels in collaborating with individuals from diverse backgrounds.

● Knowledge of community\-based service providers is a plus.

● Possesses high energy and a strong sense of initiative, capable of working both

independently and within a team.

● A good sense of humor.

● Maintain a valid driver’s license and ensure continued access to a registered, insured

vehicle for the purpose of executing job responsibilities while delivering services to

youth within the community.

**Duties include:**

● Provide intensive case management by maintaining regular contact with 15\-20 youth in the community through weekly in\-person visits and consistent connections to support their reentry.

● Evaluate each referral to determine the youth’s unique reentry needs, requirements and tailored goals. Develop and document pre\-release and post\-entry plans that address both their immediate and future needs and objectives.

● Provide intensive reentry support and make referrals and establish specific linkages to health, mental health, employment, housing, skill development, mentorship, and social and recreational services.

● Establish and maintain effective contact with the client’s family members, community providers, social workers, attorneys, educational services, employment services, housing programs, treatment providers, and probation personnel.

● Serve as the client’s key advocate, attend Child and Family Team meetings, and evaluate their progress in meeting goals and make adjustments to further support their success.

● Maintain case files and excellent documentation while tracking progress and outcomes.

● Research and build on current knowledge of available community reentry resources.

● Utilize a unified system of care through a network of community\-based agencies.

● Write and submit monthly reports for the Court, attend court hearings, and provide testimony.

● Carry out all assigned responsibilities in a professional and timely manner.

**Compensation and Benefits include:**

CJCJ offers a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, a positive work environment, and a great team of committed professionals. This is a 29\-hours per week, part\-time hourly position with pay ranging from $30 to $32 per hour, depending on experience. Benefits include complete health, dental, and life insurance with zero employee contributions. CJCJ pays 100% of the premiums. Additional benefits include an employer\-matched retirement account, 13 holidays per year, 10 sick days per year, and 10 vacation days per year. The position also offers extraordinary opportunities for paid training, professional development, and supervision.

Send your resume and cover letter with "Case Manager" in the subject line to cjcjoffice@gmail.com as soon as possible. This position is hiring to fill immediately. The application period will close as soon as the position is filled.

============


We are a small team that cares about deep thinking, speed, craftsmanship, and putting customers first. Our mission is to build the best care experience in healthcare, on a 30 year horizon.


We help physicians achieve independence by making it easier to start, operate, and grow their practices. We believe the future of healthcare will be driven by individual physicians, not by large bureaucratic systems. Lowering the barrier to practice ownership lets doctors deliver better care for everyone.


The founding team brings deep expertise across medicine, product, operations, and engineering, including more than 30 years of experience running independent practices across urgent care centers, surgical centers, and beyond. We have built 0\-to\-1 products at Meta, Dropbox, Instagram, Coda, and Nomad, and have founded companies with valuations exceeding $1B and more than 100M MAU.

**Highlights**
--------------

* We have strong product market fit. $15M\+ ARR in under 15 months.

------------


You will turn market strategy into execution across growth, physician operations, and business performance. You will work closely with physicians and frontline teams, solve operational problems, improve practice performance, and help build the systems needed to scale across the state.


This is a hands\-on role. You will move between analyzing performance, launching new initiatives, working directly with practices, and partnering with product and engineering to build better operational tools.


You will also help shape how we build AI\-native operations. That means rethinking workflows from first principles, identifying where automation can create leverage, and knowing where human judgment and relationships still matter.

**Responsibilities**

* Own key growth and operational initiatives across California.
* Work directly with physicians and practice teams to identify problems and improve performance.

* Identify opportunities to make workflows automated, AI\-assisted, or more efficient.
* Partner with product, engineering, and central teams to turn operational needs into scalable solutions.

**You Might Be a Fit If**
-------------------------

* You have 3–5 years of experience in operations, strategy, consulting, healthcare, startups, or another high\-growth environment.
* You can move seamlessly between strategy and hands\-on execution.
* You understand how to redesign operations around AI rather than simply add technology to existing processes.
* You have strong judgment about where automation creates leverage and where human involvement creates a better experience.
* You are a self\-starter who can develop a plan and execute it end to end.
* You are comfortable solving complex problems with limited structure or information.
* You have a roll\-up\-your\-sleeves approach and are willing to work directly with teams and customers.
* You move quickly, hold a high bar for quality, and take full ownership of results.
* You are a thoughtful, low\-ego teammate. We want to play long\-term games with long\-term people..

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Medical insurance through Blue Shield of California, with multiple PPO and HMO options
* Dental and vision insurance
* Unlimited PTO
* Lunch in the office

The job is to move the brand from talking about itself to making other people talk about it — through proof, craft, and community. new_jobs.title: Training Lead, Safety & Operations
new_jobs.description:
### **Who we are**



Gatik, the leader in autonomous middle\-mile logistics, is revolutionizing the B2B supply chain with its autonomous transportation\-as\-a\-service (ATaaS) solution and prioritizing safe, consistent deliveries while streamlining freight movement by reducing congestion. The company focuses on short\-haul, B2B logistics for Fortune 500 retailers and in 2021 launched the world's first fully driverless commercial transportation service with Walmart. Gatik's Class 3\-7 autonomous trucks are commercially deployed across major markets, including Texas, Arkansas, and Ontario, Canada, driving innovation in freight transportation.



The company's proprietary Level 4 autonomous technology, Gatik Carrier™, is custom\-built to transport freight safely and efficiently between pick\-up and drop\-off locations on the middle mile. With robust capabilities in both highway and urban environments, Gatik Carrier™ serves as an all\-encompassing solution that integrates advanced software and hardware powering the fleet, facilitating effortless integration into customers' logistics operations.


### **About the role**



The Head of Training establishes, matures, and leads the technical training infrastructure across all operational sites. This role ensures that testing, field deployment, and engineering support teams operate at the highest standards of safety, technical competence, and operational efficiency.



This role is onsite 5 days a week at our Santa Clara, CA office!



### **What you'll do**


* **Program Development \& Maturity:** Build, refine, and standardize training curricula for testing, deployment, and engineering support personnel, aligning content directly with safety benchmarks and operational milestones.
* **Technical Translation \& End\-to\-End Execution:** Take complex technical engineering material and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), translate them into clear, accessible training materials, and execute the resulting training programs end\-to\-end.
* **Critical Procedures \& Processes:** Take responsibility for ensuring the organization is thoroughly trained on all critical procedures and processes, embedding standard operating procedures (SOPs) deeply into daily workflows to maintain strict safety and operational integrity.
* **Administrative Compliance \& Traceability:** Implement rigorous record\-keeping frameworks to monitor, document, and audit all training metrics, ensuring total traceability and audit\-readiness across the organization.
* **Quality Assurance \& Delivery Oversight:** Audit and evaluate field trainers to ensure faithful, standardized execution of training content and rigorous testing methodologies across all facilities.
* **Continuous Elevation \& Real\-Time Monitoring:** Establish dynamic competency matrices to track team capabilities in real\-time, delivering ongoing learning modules to continuously elevate technical skills alongside hardware/software updates.
* **Retraining \& Recertification:** Develop, maintain, and execute structured retraining workflows to address skill gaps, post\-incident remediation, and routine safety recertifications.

### **What we're looking for**


* **Autonomous Systems Experience:** Demonstrated track record leading technical training or operational safety programs within the autonomous vehicle (AV), deployed robotics, or safety\-critical technology sectors.
* **Commercial Trucking Awareness:** Strong technical familiarity or direct experience with autonomous commercial trucking operations, including operational logistics and related safety protocols, is highly preferred.
* **Multi\-Site Leadership:** Proven ability to scale training operations, manage remote trainers, and standardize processes across geographically distributed operational hubs.
* **Administrative Rigor:** Experience utilizing Enterprise Learning Management Systems (LMS) and capability tracking platforms with strict data integrity requirements.
* **Willingness to Travel:** Ability to travel frequently to all operational, testing, and deployment locations.


Salary Range \- $180,000\- $260,000


### **More about Gatik**



Founded in 2017 by experts in autonomous vehicle technology, Gatik has rapidly expanded its presence to Mountain View, Dallas\-Fort Worth, Arkansas, and Toronto. As the *first and only* company to achieve fully driverless middle\-mile commercial deliveries, Gatik holds a unique and defensible position in the AV industry, with a clear trajectory toward sustainable growth and profitability.



We have delivered complete, proprietary AV technology \- an integration of software and hardware \- to enable earlier successes for our clients in constrained Level 4 autonomy. By choosing the middle mile – with defined point\-to\-point delivery, we have simplified some of the more complex AV challenges, enabling us to achieve full autonomy ahead of competitors. Given extensive knowledge of Gatik's well\-defined, fixed route ODDs and hybrid architecture, we are able to hyper\-optimize our models with exponentially less data, establish gate\-keeping mechanisms to maintain explainability, and ensure continued safety of the system for unmanned operations.



Visit us at Gatik for more company information and Careers at Gatik for more open roles.

---------------


As an Sr Sales Rep you will have the exciting opportunity to help drive the growth and shape the future of globally recognizable brands. Your responsibilities will include driving revenue, adoption, and market penetration in enterprise accounts. The ideal candidate will possess both a sales and technical background that enables them to drive an engagement at the CXO level as well as with software developers and IT architects. You will be the acting as the territory leader and working with a cross functional team, shaping the strategy for partners, professional services, and training/certification. You will develop and execute against a territory strategy and consistently deliver on quarterly revenue targets.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

The Sr. Sales rep is responsible for teaming with all aspects of the customer’s organization. This includes C\-level executives, engineering, IT/operations, partner org, and sales. Skills required to build relationships across an account include creative systems thinking, visioning, and executing via collaboration with an extended team to address all Financial Services customer's needs.  

The Sr.Sales Rep is responsible for selling at the most strategic (C\-level) within the account and implementing a broad strategy for earning customer acceptance and service implementation.  

The Sr.Sales Rep works collaboratively with all appropriate AWS resources (Executives, Partner, Support, Solution Architect) to support customer interests, and will understand how to strongly advocate for the customer in harmony with what the AWS business needs.  

In addition to new service adoption and new line of business development, this role includes dotted line responsibility for partnership and technical collaboration.  

  

About the team  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 8\+ years of technology sales experience
* Bachelor's degree, or experience in a relevant field
* Experience working with and presenting to C\-level executives, IT, and lines of businesses across organizations or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience selling cloud solutions at a software company or equivalent
* Experience as a quota\-carrying technology field sales professional with a proven track record of success selling complex cloud solutions to large enterprises within Business Services
* Experience with the AWS platform, web services, software development, or related technologies

At Five Below our growth is a result of the people who embrace our purpose: We know life is way better when you are free to Let Go \& Have Fun in an amazing experience, filled with unlimited possibilities, priced so low, you can always say yes to the newest, coolest stuff! Just ask any of our over 20,000 associates who work at Five Below and they’ll tell you there’s no other place like it. It all starts with our purpose and then, The Five Below Way, which is our values and behaviors that each and every associate believes in.


It’s all about culture at Five Below, making this a place that can inspire you as much as you inspire us with big ideas, super energy, passion, and the ability to make the workplace a WOWplace!

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Ensures all crew members are Wowing the Customer through personal contact with customers. Trains the crew on the B.E.S.T. customer service experience; ensuring that each guest has a fast, friendly check out experience.
* Helps oversee the daily activities of all store associates, ensuring they are performing their duties effectively and providing excellent customer service.
* Assists with the receiving, unpacking, and organizing of new stock to ensure items are quickly and efficiently placed on the sales floor
* Acts as Manager on Duty when needed, taking full responsibility for store operations, staff management, customer service, and addressing any urgent issues.

* High School Graduate or equivalent
* College experience preferred

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to multi\-task
* Creative thinking
* Ability to maintain composure under pressure

* Frequently ascend/descend ladders in order to retrieve and put away stock

new_jobs.description:
**A Better Built World**
------------------------


At Miter, we’re on a mission to help construction contractors build with confidence. If we’re successful, we’ll make it easier and faster to build critical physical infrastructure \- roads, bridges, utilities, data centers, housing, etc.


For decades, construction and field services contractors have had to run their businesses on outdated software: clunky, on\-premise systems created in the 1980s and 1990s.


That’s where Miter comes in. We’re using AI and embedded payments to rebuild the core HR, finance, and operations systems that underpin our physical economy. Using Miter, contractors like Marathon Electrical, W.J. O’Neil, and Truebeck Construction are building stronger teams, controlling job costs, and accelerating jobsite execution.


This idea is resonating. Since we launched in 2021, we’ve grown to thousands of customers and tens of millions in ARR, making us one of the fastest growing vertical software companies ever. To double\-down on our momentum, we’ve raised $50M\+ from top investors (Bessemer, Coatue, and Battery) who share our belief that we’re just getting started.


Miter is the operating system for the construction industry — helping construction companies manage payroll, HR, and finance in one platform built for how the field actually works. Our Customer Support team is the front line for every payroll, benefits, and tax question our customers run into, and we're looking for a Manager, Customer Support to lead and grow a subset of that team: owning queue health, SLA performance, escalations, and coaching across our entire platform.

**What You'll Do**

* Lead and grow a subset of the Customer Support frontline team, owning day\-to\-day queue health, SLA performance, escalations, and coaching across our entire platform.
* Set and drive SLA and productivity targets for your team, using support metrics (SLA, CSAT, cases/day, backlog) to spot problems early and act on them.
* Serve as the escalation point and QA authority for complex payroll, tax, and benefits\-enrollment cases, ensuring the team's toughest tickets get resolved accurately and fast.
* Assist in hiring, onboarding, and developing support ICs — building or refining specialization and escalation paths as the team scales.
* Coach with a player\-coach mindset: lead by example, give direct feedback, and grow people toward the next level, while personally working customer cases when volume or urgency demands it.
* Configure and optimize our help desk/ticketing platform — queues, routing, macros, and reporting — to keep the team efficient as ticket volume grows.
* Ramp quickly on our product and build the coaching/training frameworks that help your team do the same.
* Set clear standards and hold your team accountable to SLAs, without sacrificing team morale or the customer experience.

**What You'll Need**

* 4\+ years in customer support/success, including 2\+ years managing a support team at a payroll, HR tech, construction software, or accounting software company.
* Enough payroll depth to hold your own on construction\-specific complexity — certified payroll, prevailing wage, union fringes, and multi\-state field crews — or a demonstrated ability to get there fast.
* A track record of hitting and improving SLA and productivity targets for a queue\-driven team.
* Experience hiring, onboarding, and developing support ICs; building or refining specialization/escalation paths.
* Comfort operating in a fast\-paced, ticket\- or queue\-driven environment.
* Fluency in help desk/ticketing platforms (Pylon, Zendesk, Intercom, Front) — configuring queues, routing, macros, and reporting, not just using them.
* Comfort building and reading support metrics (SLA, CSAT, cases/day, backlog) and acting on them.
* A strong enough grasp of the payroll/tax/benefits domain to be the team's escalation point and QA complex cases.
* Ability to ramp quickly on a complex SaaS product, and experience building coaching/training frameworks for a team. Comfort utilizing AI tools and workflows.
* A player\-coach mindset — leading by example, giving direct feedback, and growing people toward the next level, while being willing to work customer cases directly when volume or urgency demands it.
* High ownership under pressure.
* The ability to set clear standards and hold a team to SLAs without hurting morale.
* An empathetic, service\-minded approach, with genuine curiosity about the construction industry and our customers' day\-to\-day operational reality.

**Nice to Have**

* Hands\-on familiarity with construction or accounting software — Sage, Intacct, Procore, Viewpoint, Foundation, or similar — either as a user, implementer, or support professional.

**Location \& Compensation**


This is an M1\-level role, with target base compensation of approximately $150K. Final range and location details will be confirmed during the hiring process.

**Our Benefits:**
-----------------

* **Competitive Compensation:** We offer competitive (well above “market”) salary, commission, and equity packages.
* **Medical Insurance:** Comprehensive medical, dental, FSA, vision plans to suit you and your family’s needs.
* **401(k) Retirement Plan:** Company\-matched contributions to help you plan for your future.
* **Flexible PTO:** Take the time you need to recharge and be your best self.
* **Parental Leave:** Generous 16\-week paid leave for all parents, including adoptive and foster parents.
* **Learning \& Development:** We offer every employee an annual educational allowance to explore external professional development.
* **Office Extras:** Snacks, coffee, lunch, and commuter benefits for in\-office Mitosaurs.
* **Community**: Company\-wide and team\-specific off\-sites per year.

**Hybrid vs. Remote Approach:**
-------------------------------

new_jobs.title: Key Account Manager (West Region)
new_jobs.description:
Description:

As the world leader in calibration services, Trescal delivers precision measurement solutions across every major industry, geography, and instrument type. Our network of technical experts and accredited laboratories ensures the highest standards of quality, compliance, and performance.


The **Key Account Manager (KAM)** is responsible for maintaining, strengthening, and expanding existing customer relationships within an assigned portfolio of strategic accounts. This role focuses on account retention, organic growth, and long\-term partnership development, ensuring customers receive consistent value, high service levels, and solutions aligned with their operational and regulatory requirements.


The Key Account Manager serves as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, working cross\-functionally to identify opportunities for expanded services, improved coverage, and multi\-site or multi\-service agreements—particularly within regulated environments such as Life Sciences, Pharmaceuticals, Aerospace, and Electronics Manufacturing.

**Responsibilities:**

**Account Management \& Retention**

* Own and manage a defined portfolio of existing key accounts, acting as the primary commercial and relationship lead.
* Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders across quality, engineering, operations, and procurement.
* Ensure contract compliance, customer satisfaction, and long\-term retention through proactive engagement.

**Growth \& Expansion**

* Identify opportunities to grow revenue within existing accounts through service expansion, additional sites, bundled solutions, and contract renewals.
* Promote calibration, on\-site services, asset management, validation, and other value\-added offerings aligned to customer needs.
* Lead pricing discussions, renewals, and upsell initiatives while protecting margin and profitability.

**Customer Strategy \& Planning**

* Develop and execute account plans for each key customer, including growth objectives, service coverage, and stakeholder mapping.
* Conduct regular business reviews to assess performance, identify improvement areas, and align on future opportunities.
* Understand customer regulatory environments (e.g., ISO 17025, GMP, GxP, FDA, AS9100\) and align services accordingly.

**Operational \& Cross\-Functional Coordination**

* Serve as the liaison between customers and internal teams, including operations, quality, scheduling, and finance.
* Coordinate contract implementations, service changes, and issue resolution to ensure a seamless customer experience.
* Monitor service performance and proactively address risks related to service delivery or compliance.

**Reporting \& CRM Management**

* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date account information, opportunities, and forecasts within the CRM system.
* Provide regular updates and performance reports to sales leadership.


Requirements:
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent experience will be considered.
* 3\+ years of experience in key account management, account retention, or customer success, preferably within technical or regulated industries.
* Experience supporting Life Sciences, Aerospace, or other compliance\-driven environments strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of service\-based selling and long\-term contract management.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
* Proven ability to collaborate cross\-functionally and manage multiple priorities.
* Proficiency with CRM platforms and Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Willingness to travel periodically within the assigned region.

**Benefits:**


At Trescal, we believe our people are the cornerstone of our success. We offer comprehensive health benefits, paid time off, a 401(k) plan, professional development opportunities, and a collaborative, growth\-oriented environment.

***Trescal is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*** *All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.*

new_jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Nice to have:**
-----------------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

new_jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst - AI Scientific
new_jobs.description:
Job Title: **Senior Business Analyst \- AI Scientific \- Data statics and Programming**


Location:**Fosters City CA (****Onsite) OR** **Remote**

Job Type: **FTE**

  

  

**Job Description:**

  

  

**Primary (Must have) Skills**


* Data statics and Programming


* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Life Sciences, Health Sciences, Pharmacy, Biotechnology, Biomedical Sciences, or related discipline.


* Academic or professional experience in:


* Clinical Research
* Clinical Development
* Translational Science
* Oncology or related therapeutic areas

* Strong understanding of clinical development lifecycle and pharmaceutical development processes.
* 8\+ years of Experience working within pharmaceutical R\&D organizations.
* 8\+ years of Excellent business analysis and requirements gathering skills.
* Ability to convert ambiguous business problems into structured functional requirements.
* 5\+ years of Experience defining KPIs, success metrics, and measurable business outcomes.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Self\-driven with ability to work independently.
* Experience managing UAT activities and stakeholder communication.

We are looking for an **AI Scientific Business Analyst** who combines life sciences expertise with business analysis and AI product delivery. This role will partner with Product Managers, Business Leads, AI Engineers, and Data teams to define and deliver AI\-powered solutions that support clinical research and drug development. The ideal candidate has a strong scientific background, understands clinical development processes, and can translate complex business needs into structured AI requirements that enable successful product delivery.


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Individual contributor partner with Product Manager, Business Lead, AI Leads, and Data Lead to define AI use cases, including problem framing, success criteria, and measurable outcomes.
* Translate business needs into AI\-ready requirements, including:
* Input data expectations
* Model outputs (predictions, insights, recommendations)
* User interaction patterns (e.g., workflows, prompts, dashboards)
* Apply foundational knowledge of clinical research and drug development to ensure AI use cases, requirements, and acceptance criteria accurately reflect scientific intent and business objectives
* Act as the primary bridge between "what's needed" (business) and "what's possible" (technical) to ensure stakeholder alignment.
* Leads requirements refinement, including current/future state analysis, requirements documentation, prioritization, feasibility alignment and stakeholder alignment.
* Document user, functional and AI\-specific requirements including data inputs, model output, user interaction workflows with acceptance criteria aligned to business outcomes and system behavior.
* Owns User Acceptance Testing planning and execution.
* Partners with Testing team to ensure requirements are testable and the solution is ready for release.
  

  

**Deliverables**:


* Update and maintain user stories and acceptance criteria in Jira/ADO.
* Author formal User Requirements Specification (URS)/Functional Requirements Specification (FRS), when required
* Partners with testing teams to ensure requirements are clear, unambiguous, and testable.
* Produce current state and future state artifacts (process flows, data flows, impact summaries) as required to support solution design.
* Lead or contribute to data specifications, source\-to\-target mappings, and AI input/output definitions in partnership with Data and AI teams
* Develop User Acceptance Test (UAT) plan, scenarios, and test cases aligned to approved requirements.
* Lead UAT, including coordination of test cycles, defect logging, and retesting.

new_jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Lead
new_jobs.description:
Nobody has rebuilt a brokerage with AI before. So a lot of the strategic questions that decide how big Corridor gets don’t have answers yet, and we need to work them out over the next eighteen months.  

  

That’s the job. What does it cost us to serve a client, and how fast does that number fall as agents pick up more of the work? Which segments are worth going after and which ones are quietly losing us money? Do we grow by hiring advisors, franchising them, or buying their books, and what is a book woroth anyway? What has to change about how we’re organized when there are three times as many of us?  

  

You’ll report to our COO and work closely with our CEO.  

In this role, you will

* Figure out our unit economics, which nobody in this industry has. What a client costs to serve with AI automations, how many one person can carry once agents are doing the work, which products make money
* Build the case for our biggest growth bets, from franchising producers to general agency economics to buying books outright, then help us pick
* Work out how we hyperscale. We want to be several times this size next year, and help us think through what will break as we scale
* Automate your own job. You’ll write agent prompts and skills and stand up workflows with AI coding tools yourself, not file tickets and wait on engineering
* Own the operating rhythm. Which KPIs we hold ourselves to, getting them measured automatically instead of assembled by hand, and running the reviews where we look at them
* Pick up the important things nobody owns yet
* Build the infrastructure underneath all of this, across legal, regulatory, and people, and get it running without you

  

You’ll be a good fit if:

* You have incredibly high grit and horsepower, combined with excellent judgment
* You have 2\-6 years of experience, with a strong foundation in investment banking, private equity, consulting, or another rigorous analytical environment, and ideally time since in an operating role
* You have a strong bias for action
* You’re low\-ego
* You’re comfortable getting deep into revenue structures and unit economics
* You like running things \- you’re comfortable owning a process, a vendor, or a messy cross\-functional project end to end
* You have a track record of outperforming in selective, demanding environments
* You take a messy question, structure it fast, and get to a defensible answer
* You have good judgment on sensitive matters, and people trust you with them

**About the job**

**Company**: Persist Brands

**Job Title:** Operations Manager

**Location**: Remote. We are open to Global candidates

**Employment Type**: Full\-time/ Contract

**Reporting to:** Founder

**About Persist Brands**

Persist Brands is a fast\-growing direct\-to\-consumer eCommerce company that builds and scales aggressive direct\-response consumer brands across categories like apparel, beauty, wellness, and lifestyle. We combine performance marketing, creative testing, data analysis, and operational execution to turn consumer products into scalable offers.

We are a performance\-driven company built around speed, data, creative testing, and operational execution. Our team launches and scales products through paid media, high\-converting funnels, strong creative strategy, customer retention, and disciplined backend operations.

At Persist Brands, we move fast, test aggressively, and optimize constantly. We are looking for ambitious, resourceful, and highly accountable people who want to join a lean, growth\-focused company where their work has a direct impact on revenue, customer experience, and long\-term brand value.

**The Role**

We are seeking a hands\-on Operations Manager – Marketing eCommerce Operations to manage the operational execution supporting our eCommerce marketing and revenue activities.

The role will work closely with Marketing, Media Buying, Creative, Payments, Finance, Customer Support, and Suppliers to ensure products, campaigns, offers, websites, and operational workflows are launch\-ready and perform efficiently.

The ideal candidate combines eCommerce operations knowledge with strong project management, data analysis, and cross\-functional coordination skills and is comfortable working in a fast\-paced startup environment.

**What You'll Do:**

**1\. Marketing \& eCommerce Operations**

* Coordinate the operational execution of product launches, promotions, offers, and marketing campaigns.
* Ensure products, pricing, offers, landing pages, tracking, and supporting operational requirements are ready before campaigns go live.
* Coordinate with Marketing and Media Buying teams on campaign requirements, timelines, and operational dependencies.
* Monitor campaign\-related operational issues and ensure timely resolution.

**2\. Product \& Supplier Operations**

* Coordinate with suppliers to ensure product availability, pricing, product information, fulfillment capability, and promotional requirements are aligned with marketing plans.
* Maintain accurate product, supplier, pricing, and operational information across internal systems.
* Identify potential supply, fulfillment, or product issues that could impact marketing campaigns or customer experience.
* Support onboarding and ongoing performance management of suppliers.

**3\. Campaign \& Performance Coordination**

* Track operational KPIs that impact marketing performance, including order volume, cancellations, refunds, fulfillment issues, product availability, and customer complaints.
* Work with Marketing and Finance to identify operational factors affecting CPA, CAC, ROAS, revenue, and contribution margin.
* Provide regular operational insights and reports to the CFO/Founder.
* Identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements.

**4\. Cross\-Functional Operations**

* Act as the operational bridge between Marketing, Payments, Finance, Customer Support, and Suppliers.
* Coordinate timelines, dependencies, and issue resolution across teams.
* Ensure marketing initiatives are operationally feasible before execution.
* Escalate high\-impact issues and delays to the CFO/Founder.

**5\. Process \& Systems Management**

* Build and maintain SOPs for marketing and eCommerce operational workflows.
* Improve processes related to product launches, campaign setup, order flows, supplier coordination, and issue management.
* Maintain accurate operational data across CRM, eCommerce, project management, and reporting systems.
* Identify opportunities for automation and process efficiency.

**What We're Looking For:**

* 7–10 years of experience in eCommerce operations, marketing operations, DTC, performance marketing operations, or a related field.
* Experience supporting eCommerce marketing campaigns, product launches, and revenue operations.
* Strong understanding of the relationship between marketing activities and downstream eCommerce operations.
* Experience coordinating with suppliers, fulfillment partners, payment teams, and internal business functions.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills and experience working with operational data.
* Strong project management and cross\-functional communication skills.
* Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced startup environment.

**Deal Breakers:**

* Experience with Shopify or similar eCommerce platforms.
* Experience supporting Meta, Google, TikTok, or other paid acquisition channels from an operational perspective.
* Experience with DTC brands, dropshipping, or performance\-driven eCommerce.
* Familiarity with CRM, analytics, project management, and marketing technology platforms.
* Experience working in a startup or lean eCommerce environment.

**Compensation \& Benefits:**

* Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, relevant experience, skills, location, internal equity, and other business\-related factors.

Pay: From $3,500\.00 per month

They represent Biogen within the communities, providing education and support for patients and caregivers.
  

They build strong connections with key stakeholders in their area, both external and internal. In addition to establishing relationships with local patients and caregivers, they interact with local advocacy representatives and HCPs in support of PNH and C3G/IC\-MPGN patient/caregiver communities.
