------------------------


At Miter, we’re on a mission to help construction contractors build with confidence. If we’re successful, we’ll make it easier and faster to build critical physical infrastructure \- roads, bridges, utilities, data centers, housing, etc.


For decades, construction and field services contractors have had to run their businesses on outdated software: clunky, on\-premise systems created in the 1980s and 1990s.


That’s where Miter comes in. We’re using AI and embedded payments to rebuild the core HR, finance, and operations systems that underpin our physical economy. Using Miter, contractors like Marathon Electrical, W.J. O’Neil, and Truebeck Construction are building stronger teams, controlling job costs, and accelerating jobsite execution.


This idea is resonating. Since we launched in 2021, we’ve grown to thousands of customers and tens of millions in ARR, making us one of the fastest growing vertical software companies ever. To double\-down on our momentum, we’ve raised $50M\+ from top investors (Bessemer, Coatue, and Battery) who share our belief that we’re just getting started.


Miter is the operating system for the construction industry — helping construction companies manage payroll, HR, and finance in one platform built for how the field actually works. Our Customer Support team is the front line for every payroll, benefits, and tax question our customers run into, and we're looking for a Manager, Customer Support to lead and grow a subset of that team: owning queue health, SLA performance, escalations, and coaching across our entire platform.

**What You'll Do**

* Lead and grow a subset of the Customer Support frontline team, owning day\-to\-day queue health, SLA performance, escalations, and coaching across our entire platform.
* Set and drive SLA and productivity targets for your team, using support metrics (SLA, CSAT, cases/day, backlog) to spot problems early and act on them.

* Assist in hiring, onboarding, and developing support ICs — building or refining specialization and escalation paths as the team scales.
* Coach with a player\-coach mindset: lead by example, give direct feedback, and grow people toward the next level, while personally working customer cases when volume or urgency demands it.
* Configure and optimize our help desk/ticketing platform — queues, routing, macros, and reporting — to keep the team efficient as ticket volume grows.
* Ramp quickly on our product and build the coaching/training frameworks that help your team do the same.
* Set clear standards and hold your team accountable to SLAs, without sacrificing team morale or the customer experience.

**What You'll Need**

* 4\+ years in customer support/success, including 2\+ years managing a support team at a payroll, HR tech, construction software, or accounting software company.

* Comfort operating in a fast\-paced, ticket\- or queue\-driven environment.
* Fluency in help desk/ticketing platforms (Pylon, Zendesk, Intercom, Front) — configuring queues, routing, macros, and reporting, not just using them.
* Comfort building and reading support metrics (SLA, CSAT, cases/day, backlog) and acting on them.
* A strong enough grasp of the payroll/tax/benefits domain to be the team's escalation point and QA complex cases.
* Ability to ramp quickly on a complex SaaS product, and experience building coaching/training frameworks for a team. Comfort utilizing AI tools and workflows.
* A player\-coach mindset — leading by example, giving direct feedback, and growing people toward the next level, while being willing to work customer cases directly when volume or urgency demands it.
* High ownership under pressure.
* The ability to set clear standards and hold a team to SLAs without hurting morale.
* An empathetic, service\-minded approach, with genuine curiosity about the construction industry and our customers' day\-to\-day operational reality.

**Nice to Have**

* Hands\-on familiarity with construction or accounting software — Sage, Intacct, Procore, Viewpoint, Foundation, or similar — either as a user, implementer, or support professional.

This is an M1\-level role, with target base compensation of approximately $150K. Final range and location details will be confirmed during the hiring process.

You will ensure each customer achieves measurable value from our software and data products and services, leading to satisfaction, retention, and growth of their account with us. This role contributes directly to the achievement of J.D. Power sales growth by playing a critical role in the total customer experience. The successful candidate will have a combination of interpersonal skills, strategic thinking, strong follow\-up, and business acumen.


You will tailor your engagement to the customer’s tier and unique product characteristics, providing high\-touch, strategic partnership for customers.  



**The Impact You Will Have in This Role:** In this role, you will directly influence customer satisfaction, retention, and growth by helping automotive dealers maximize the value of our software and data solutions. As a trusted advisor, you will build strong customer relationships, proactively address risks, and drive product adoption to deliver measurable business outcomes. Your ability to partner across teams and provide strategic guidance will play a critical role in enhancing the customer experience, strengthening long\-term customer loyalty, and contributing to J.D. Power's overall growth objectives.  



**What You’ll Be Doing in This Role:**

**Customer Partnership \& Advocacy**

* Serve as the primary point\-of\-contract and advocate for your assigned customer portfolio, ensuring alignment between customer use cases and our solutions.
* Develop strategies to retain existing customers and prevent churn.
* Engage with customers based on defined segmentation, tiering strategy, and account playbooks.
* Act as a strategic advisor—translating customer business goals into actionable success plans and measurable outcomes.
* Partner with Customer Solutions on requested product enhancements, including customer feedback by representing the Voice of Customer (VoC).
* Conduct Quarterly or Executive Business Reviews (QBRs/EBRs) with highest tier customers to review performance, usage, ROI, and future opportunities. QBR’s are based on customer tier and in collaboration with Sales.

**Retention, Growth, and Value Realization**

* Retain existing customers through strong engagement and making sure accounts successfully renew their subscriptions.
* Proactively monitor customer product usage, particularly after implementation, to identify risks and opportunities for account growth. Engage with customers based on performance and usage.
* Develop and execute renewal and growth plans, in partnership with Sales, to drive Net Revenue Retention (NRR) across accounts.
* Identify and communicate ROI stories and value outcomes to reinforce the customer’s strategic partnership with J.D. Power.
* Identify upsell and cross\-sell products to existing Darwin customers, in collaboration with Sales with a special emphasis on new and priority products and services

**Operational Excellence \& Process Improvement**

* Partner cross\-functionally to resolve customer issues quickly, ensuring consistent, high\-quality service delivery. You’ll partner with Customer Solutions, Product teams, Sales, Implementation, and Customer Support teams
* Identify and share best practices to improve internal processes and enhance customer experience.
* Support development and implementation of product playbooks across customer tiers
* Ensure smooth transition from Implementation to BAU for customers through interaction with the Implementation team and process

new_jobs.title: HPG Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
As an HPG Account Manager at HPG Brands, you’ll be the driving force behind inside sales success. This customer\-facing role is all about building meaningful relationships, generating new opportunities, and delivering exceptional service across all HPG subsidiaries. Working closely with our Outside and National Sales teams, as well as Sales Coordinators, you’ll play a critical role in expanding business within your assigned region.
  
  

What You’ll Do
  
  

* Drive revenue by meeting or exceeding monthly sales targets across all HPG brands.
* Proactively connect with customers via phone, email, and video to discuss campaigns, share solutions, and drive brand engagement.
* Support Outside Sales in meetings and follow\-ups to help close deals and expand accounts.
* Identify new opportunities within existing accounts through consultative relationship management.
* Maintain a healthy sales pipeline and forecast future growth opportunities.
* Deliver fast, friendly, and effective customer service—including handling inbound calls and product suggestions for projects.
* Provide accurate and timely quotes, marketing support, and product education.
* Train and guide customers on HPG’s suite of sales tools, resources, and programs.
* Keep CRM (NetSuite) records clean and up to date with customer interactions and sales activities.
* Collaborate across teams to solve challenges, support fulfillment, and ensure a top\-tier customer experience.
* Celebrate wins—big or small—through follow\-up thank\-you calls and relationship touches.


Who You Are
  
  

* A sales\-driven relationship builder with strong communication skills and a passion for problem\-solving.
* Organized and adaptable—you can juggle multiple tasks and pivot quickly when priorities shift.
* A team player who thrives independently, takes initiative, and knows when to ask for support.
* Detail\-oriented with strong accuracy and follow\-through on commitments.
* Naturally curious and eager to learn—especially when it comes to products, trends, and customer needs.


Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
* 1\+ year of sales or account management experience (industry experience a plus).
* Strong Microsoft Office and CRM skills (NetSuite preferred).
* Experience in the promotional products or B2B industry is a plus, but not required.


Bonus Skills
  
  

* Knowledge of the promo industry landscape and seasonal buying patterns.
* Experience presenting via video conferencing tools.
* Familiarity with digital marketing or sales enablement tools.


Working Conditions
  
  

* Remote or office\-based with regular use of standard office equipment.
* Ability to sit or stand for extended periods and occasionally lift up to 15 lbs.
* Must be able to clearly read and distinguish color in product details or samples.


Why Join HPG Brands?
  
  

HPG is a powerhouse in the promotional products space, with a reputation for innovation, award\-winning service, and a portfolio of sought\-after brands. You’ll be part of a collaborative, energetic team with real growth opportunities and the support to help you succeed.

new_jobs.title: Campaign Operations Specialist
new_jobs.description:
Jama Software® is focused on maximizing innovation success in multidisciplinary engineering organizations. Numerous firsts for humanity in fields such as fuel cells, electrification, space, software\-defined vehicles, surgical robotics, and more all rely on Jama Connect® requirements management softwareto minimize the risk of defects, rework, cost overruns, and recalls. Using Jama Connect, engineering organizations can now intelligently manage the development process by leveraging Live Traceability™ across best\-of\-breed tools to measurably improve outcomes. Additionally, customers have access to cutting edge AI functionality to modernize their requirements workflows and processes. Our rapidly growing customer base spans the automotive, medical device, life sciences, semiconductor, aerospace \& defense, industrial manufacturing, consumer electronics, financial services, and insurance industries.


The Campaign Operations Specialist is responsible for executing campaigns and supporting marketing programs within established frameworks. Applies working knowledge of systems and processes to deliver reliable results. Begins identifying opportunities for efficiency and improvement.


**What You'll Do:**
-------------------


* Executes campaigns end\-to\-end (build, QA, launch)
* Creates basic automation (email nurtures, triggers)
* Troubleshoots common system or campaign issues
* Suggests small improvements to workflows
* Understands campaign goals and KPIs, aligns work to team\-level objectives (Demand Gen, Events, etc.)
* Builds and modifies reports/dashboards
* Identifies straightforward data issues and resolves them

**What You'll Bring:**
----------------------


* Demonstrated ability to collaborate across teams
* Working knowledge of MAP/CRM functionality
* Campaign structures, segmentation, and automation basics
* Understanding of team KPIs and campaign goals
* Work independently within established frameworks
* Prioritize multiple projects effectively
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with presentation experience
* A passion for data, metrics and reporting with experience using attribution reporting tools (RCE preferred)
* 1\-3 years of marketing operations experience
* Strong experience with email marketing in a B2B environment, with emphasis on deliverability

* Adobe Marketo Engage Digital Marketer Professional, Adobe Marketo Engage Business Practitioner Professional (or equivalent)

**Perks and Benefits:**
-----------------------


* Virtual first and culturally diverse work environment spanning 8 countries.
* Ambitious and fun work with a chance to define distinct, company\-shaping tangible contributions.
* Flexible time off and leave programs crafted to meet the needs for your rejuvenation and extra support to cope with life events with a quarterly $75 wellness reimbursement.
* Comprehensive and affordable medical, dental and vision plans with pre\-tax savings accounts and a generous 401(k) employer match.
* 6\+ weeks of paid parental leave to bond with your new family member.
* Emphasis on learning and development at all levels with a subscription to LinkedIn Learning.

We're eager to meet people that believe in Jama Software's mission and can contribute to our team in a variety of ways – not just candidates who check all the boxes.



Jama Software is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to any characteristic protected under federal, state, or applicable law.

Please contact us at recruiting@jamasoftware.com to request an accommodation.

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Professional
new_jobs.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.


At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.


This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

**The Role**
------------



The Customer Success Professional is a customer\-facing role that ensures our Large Enterprise customers are wildly successful in delivering on their critical business objectives through leveraging their current Lumen solutions. This is accomplished by viewing our products from the customers’ perspective, monitoring early indicators of customer health, proactively addressing their concerns, and helping them better use our technology to meet their corporate goals and objectives. With established trust and loyalty, this role seeks to naturally progress and expand the partnership through identifying potential up\-sell and cross\-sell opportunities and engaging sales accordingly.

**The Main Responsibilities**
-----------------------------


* Implement customer success plans using standardized journey templates to set customer expectations and ensure they are prepared for key milestones through the lifecycle (Get, Use, Pay and Renew), reinforce ecosystem hand\-offs, and empower customers to self\-serve Leverage and manage overall customer metrics , which include customer usage data, health indicators (disconnects, credits, orders, churn propensity scores, NPS), and renewal dates with a holistic view that aligns with customer objectives/success metrics Evaluate current product and portal adoption maturity level (depth and breadth) and address roadblocks by leveraging digital marketing slicks, adoption articles and other templates
* Know the Lumen portfolio offerings well enough to recognize a potential opportunity for expansion and ask appropriate questions to further qualify the opportunity, partnering closely with sales
* Implement revenue management practices, driving accountability and alignment of our operations and financial goals, revenue retention and growth strategies which include value realization, renewal execution, risk management and customer growth/expansion
* Communicate, escalate, and drive mitigation plans cross\-functionally to de\-risk accounts,handle urgent customer concerns and escalate internally when necessary (ie, Service Improvement Plans)
* Partner with sales, delivery and support to ensure successful deployment of solutions and services including periodic first bill reviews and audits to minimize billing disputes Responsible for renewal and re\-rate implementation via contract end\-date management, leveraging renewals to influence customer technology evolution while incorporating on\-net migrations that improve Lumen profit margins
**What We Look For in a Candidate**
-----------------------------------


* Experience: 3\+ years customer success or account management experience
* Education Level: Bachelor's Degree OR equivalent work experience
* Experience working with and supporting enterprise customers, evaluating, and responding to needs with empathy and integrity
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with ability to build relationships within customer accounts
* Ability to proactively problem solve, make decisions on issue resolution while effectively negotiating directly with the customer and internally on their behalf
* Technical aptitude to learn data networking technologies, products, and features
* A high level of accuracy and attention to detail with good organizational capabilities
* Ability to interpret customer data points and insights, prioritize and respond accordingly
* Prioritize and manage multiple workstreams and task lists with strong time management skills
* Ability to quickly learn various software, web\-based platforms, and systems in accessing data
* Working knowledge of MS Office suite
**Compensation**
----------------


This information reflects the anticipated base salary range for this position based on current national data. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. Individual pay is based on skills, experience and other relevant factors.  

  

Location Based Pay Ranges  

  

$55,671 \- $74,221 in these states: AL AR AZ FL GA IA ID IN KS KY LA ME MO MS MT ND NE NM OH OK PA SC SD TN UT VT WI WV WY
  

$58,456 \- $77,938 in these states: CO HI MI MN NC NH NV OR RI
  

$61,240 \- $81,643 in these states: AK CA CT DC DE IL MA MD NJ NY TX VA WA
  

  

Lumen offers a comprehensive package featuring a broad range of Health, Life, Voluntary Lifestyle benefits and other perks that enhance your physical, mental, emotional and financial wellbeing. We're able to answer any additional questions you may have about our bonus structure (short\-term incentives, long\-term incentives and/or sales compensation) as you move through the selection process.  

  


Learn more about Lumen's:  


Benefits  

Bonus Structure


\#LI\-Remote

**What to Expect Next**
-----------------------

Life at Lumen is human and connected, even in a fast moving, AI‑focused organization. We set clear expectations and trust people to meet them. With real support and shared accountability, teams collaborate better, move faster, and deliver meaningful outcomes.


Our Lumen 8 behaviors guide how we interact, make decisions, and work together, shaping a culture built to perform and win.
